tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// snying gzer nag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga khrag 'thung rol pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes spyi gzugs khro bo'i rgyal la 'gyur ba med pa mthing khar chags// rnam thar sgo gsum rngam pa'i zhal dang pha rol phyin drug phyag ste bsdu ba bzhi dngos zhabs// gsung ni drag po'i sngags so rjes chags thugs las gar dgu'i nyams byung mi zad yon tan brgyan// 'phrin las 'od kyi 'phreng ba cher 'khrug 'jam dpal dpa' bo gshin rje'i dgra der phyag 'tshal lo// rmongs zhen mun pa'i snyems pa bcil gyur pas// legs bshad snang ba'i gtam yang bskal dus 'dir// dgongs don nam mkha'i thig le lhag bsam gyis// drang bar 'os zhes rig 'dzin ches bskul tshe// bgrod pa gsum gyis thams cad mkhyen 'dod rnams// ngag dbang rdo rje'i ā ra lis rol bas// sgyu 'phrul nyams brgya'i 'khor lo cher 'chang ba'i// kun bzang spyod pa'i gsang tshig 'don la zhugs/ /slob dpon mtshan nyid de yi las// slob ma 'jug cing lha ngo bstan// dbang bskur ba bzhi spyi yi chings// dang po 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis// goms pa sngon sbyangs mang thos chos rnams shes// chos nyid mnyam pa'i don rig gti mug med// dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med zung 'jug tu// bla ma'i man ngag thob pa'i gdengs ldan pa'i// yon tan rdzogs pa bla ma dam par bya// gnyis par bsnyen dang sa chog dang*// sta gon dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa 'o// dus grangs mtshan ma rdzogs pas slar// dbang bskur sngon du kha gso bya// sa chog la ni bslang dang brtag /sa lha dbang bya chag chag 'dul// baṃ blang ba yang zhar las so// snang ba yul gyi bdag por bslang*// mi snang der phyin gser skyems gtor// gtor ma byin brlabs 'di brjod do/ /hūm̐ gang yang sa la gnas pa dang*// sa la rgyu ba'i lha klu rnams// mchod dang gtor ma 'di longs la// sems can kun dge don du yang*// byams pa'i sems kyis gnang bar mdzod// phyogs 'dir ci dgar spyod cig ces// gnang ba byin nas mi snang song*/

༈ de nas lto 'phye brtag pa ni// rang gi pho brang 'khor bas te// gzhogs g.yon 'og tu bcug nas ni// zla ba dag la bskor ba yin// dpyid gsum mgo ni nub tu bstan// dbyar gsum mgo byang ston gsum shar// dgun gsum lhor bstan gling phyed khyab// byang shar lto nye'i thad nas brko// yid ches min na ro lnga bsal// rin po che dang lho phyogs kyi// bkra shis sas dgang stegs bu bca'/ ༈ de nas sa lha mchod pa'i phyir// zil gnon lus dkyil bzhin du bsgom/ a+ye ring bsnyen pa'i man ngag bzhin bya/ /stegs bu dris byugs tshom bu bkod// mchod yon nyer spyod gtor ma bsham// mi bskyod phyag rgya sar brdabs gas/ /hūm̐/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyis// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// shākya seng ge skyob pa yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag kyang bdud sde las// rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri// bstan ma gser mdog mdzes ma'i lus// phyed snang 'bum phrag 'khor bcas 'thon// pri thi bī de wī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ pra ti byaḥ.ar+ghaṃ= puṣ+pe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= naiwid+ya= shap+ta pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ pra ti byaḥn mas+sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na ba liṃ ta swāhā/ dgyes te gnang ba byin nas thim/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod ci dga' bar spyod cig /ces gnang ba byin nas de nyid du thim par gyur/ dbang bya phur pa zla gam dbal/ bdag nyid skad cig gis pad+ma he ru ka'i skur gsal bar gyur/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭ// ces pas stegs bu'i dbus su btab// pad+ma dbang gyur 'od dmar gyis// bar gcod tshar bcad tshur 'dus thim// sa chen dbang byas sar 'dzin sbyangs/ phur bu de nyid skad cig gis pad+ma dbang chen gyi skur lam gyis gsal bar gyur/

de las 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas bar du gcod pa thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus nas thim pas thams cad dbang du byas/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi la 'phros pas sar 'dzin pa'i rtog pa thams cad sbyangs par gyur// de nas bdud rtsi lnga btab pa'i// khrag chen byug bzhin 'di skad 'don/ /hūm̐ rang byung dam rdzas bdud rtsi lnga ldan pas// 'jam dpal gshin rje'i rigs mchog bsgom pa'i phyir// bka' gsang bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po la// dam rdzas gsang ba bdud rtsi'i chag chag 'debs// oṃ ma hā rak+ta a mṛ ta maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐/ chos nyid khyab gdal gyur par bsam// de nas 'dul zhing byin brlabs pa// dpon slob tshang ma zhwa dang phod// nag gyon phur bhan thogs nas su// gser skyems nas brtsams log pa rtse gsum 'gros/ kyi /bar du gang bshad 'chams kyis bsgrubs// gal te ma grub 'di yis bya// rdo rje rgyal po dbus su 'dug /rgyal theb bzhi ni sgor 'khod la// 'byung brtsegs nas gzung 'dzb bar byas/ e las e yaṃ maṃ sum keṃ raṃ chad// ces pa nas dzb bar las byang bzhin dang mthar/ ya mān+ta ka gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ sogs kyis bshags pa grub rjes// slob dpon mchod bstod gsol gdab 'di/ zhes pas/ phyogs bzhi'i mchod pa dang sman raka gtor gsum rnams/ /hūm̐ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis mchod rdzas thams cad sbyangs// sogs nas/ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭha/ bar gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ sna tshogs me tog phreng bas bcings pa ni/ sogs kyis ti ra sid+dhi hoḥ bar gyis mchod/ hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings nas go 'byed gzugs phung dgrar// sogs bstod pa yongs rdzogs rjes gsol gdab 'di ltar/ hūm̐ kun gyi rang bzhin nyid las byung*// sems nyid rdo rje 'dzin pa khyod// mi rtog rang bzhin ting 'dzin las// stobs chen rdo rje'i skur bzhengs la// lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*// phyag rgya chen po rdzogs par mdzod//

slob dpon gyis ni lha rnams bsdus/ badz+ra muḥ yum dang bcas pa'i rten brten par bcas pa thams cad bdag nyid la thim par gyur// zil gnon chen po'i nga rgyal gyis/ rang nyid zil gnon dpal chen po'i skur gyur pa'i mig gnyis ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba/ mig 'bras hūm̐ las bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar bas 'jig rten 'di la kun tu brdig cing 'bar ba'i skur gyur/ bshos chang ting lo rnams/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs nas/ hūm̐ yang gsang zhes sogs bka' bsgos nas/ hūm̐ bzhi dang*/ a+ye ring sngags kyis bskrad/ /dbus su pad+ma lta bu'i gar// g.yas g.yon dbus su me tog dor// shar du thabs shes 'gros kyis phyin// gzhi bca' g.yas brkyang gis bgegs bskrad// de nas gnod sbyin 'gros kyis lhor// gzhi bca' g.yon brkyang klu 'khyil 'gros// nub tu gzhi bca' sa ga'o// rkang gcig mchong skor 'gros kyis byang*// gzhi bca' zlum pos mtha' skor du// dpa' bo'i 'ging dang sgeg mo'i 'jol// rdo rje'i sgo ru gnam sa brdung*// dga' ba kha sbyor seng g.yal gyi'o// zhes pa ltar dang*/ shes shing spros pa la dga' na stang stabs drug cu rtsa gnyis kyang bya ste/ rdo rje rgyal po nyid kyis so// de nas khro bcu'i phur gdab ni/ bdag nyid zil gnon he ru kar gsal ba'i snying kha'i 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus phyogs bcu'i bgegs gdug pa can thams cad bkugs te/ srung 'khor gyi phyi rol phyogs mtshams steng 'og bcur bkod la/ phur bu rnams khro bo bcu/ zhal gsum phyag drug gis mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs shing sku smad phur bu 'bar ba'i dbal can du gyur/ g.yas su rdo rje tho ba dang*// g.yon du phur pa thogs nas su// dbyangs dang bcas pas bgegs la btab/ /hūm̐ snang srid 'khor lo rtsibs bcur song*/ sogs dang*/ hūm̐ steng du khro rgyal hūm̐ kā ra// sogs nas/ oṃ ma hā kro dha hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ phaṭ/

oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya gha ta ya sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya/ sarba pa paṃ phaṭa phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐/ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha rod adzñā pa ya ti sarba bigh+naṃ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra mut+gar badz+ra kī la ya ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces stang stabs dang bcas shar gyi shar du gdab/ de bzhin du shar du khro rgyal bi dzā ya/ sogs so so'i mthar gdab sngags dang bcas phyogs bzhi g.yas skor dang*/ byang shar khro rgyal gsum las rgyal/ sogs/ mtshams bzhi g.yon skor/ 'og nub kyi nub tu btab pas/ dbang po la sogs pa'i bgegs rnams spyi bo nas gsang ba'i bar phug ste gser gyi sa gzhi la sbrags nas g.yo 'gul med cing bde ba chen po'i ror gyur par bsam la phur bu rnams dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar du mi bsdu zhing bgegs thams cad bsrung ba'i las mdzad par bsam/ phur bu rnams la gu gul bdug cing yungs kar brab pas gzi byin bskyed cing brtan par bya// zhes sogs kyis so tshogs las mthar/ zhes pas tshogs dang bsgral las lhag bsngo'i bar las byang gzhung bzhin btang*// blang bsal dbang sdud zhar bstan la/ dkar gsum mngar gsum dang bcas pas sbrus pa'i mar zan la bam ro'i gzugs bcos pa de/ dur khrod kyi tshul du byas pa'i sgrub khang gi logs shig tu bzhag pa de la/ hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings las 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed// dgyes pa'i gar gyis bam chen blang ba'i phyir// gshin rje'i las mkhan thams cad pho nyar 'gyed// sogs nas/ gtum pa'i= /ti ra bam chen len pa'i las mdzod cig / ces pho nya bskul la rol mo bcas// dpa' bo chen po'i shugs kyi 'gros// g.yas brkyang ba dang mthun pa'i 'gros// g.yon brkyang sa ga zlum po dang*// rkang gcig mchong skor la sogs pa// rdo rje'i 'gros te bdun pa yin// 'dren dang bsnun dang brdeg pa dang*// ro za ba dang 'phang gis 'khyud// ri bo 'degs dang klad la skor// ye shes dbyings su rol bar byed// 'gros bdun stang stabs brgyad du grags// tshul des phyin la len rgyu'i ro// nad dang rims kyis ma shi ba// mgo kha byang shar rkang lho nub// ce spyang gzan la rgyug 'dra min// gzhan kun lo bzhi nas brtsams te// nyer lnga'i bar gyi skyes bud med// grir shi ba yi hal ba ste// rab yin 'bring ni phyi ba'i ro// tha ma lug sogs dud 'gro gzhan// sha za mkha' 'gro 'khrug bsal phyir// tshil dud btang zhing rkang dung 'bud// thod rnga brdung zhing sha chen gyis// brgyan pa'i gtor ma phul nas su/

/hūm̐ dur khrod la rgyu ti ra longs spyod ma// bam chen sha za khrag la hub kyis 'debs// rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro bde gshegs yum gyi 'khor// bdag dang khams gsum za byed chen mo yin// thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don bya ba'i phyir// ti ra bam chen 'di la longs spyod kyi// khyed dang ma sring bu mo bran dang khol// thugs kyis mnar ba ma mdzad gnyis med rol// dri dang sman gyi ro byugs la// zil gnon 'od dmar lcags kyu yis// sha za mkha' 'gro 'byung bcas kyi// snying gar btab pas dbang med 'dus// sku las khro bo me bcas spros// khams gsum gang bas de rnams gzir// drag po'i sngags kyis brgyal rmongs rengs/ zhes pas/ rang nyid khrag 'thung zil gnon chen por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ dur khrod kyi sha za mkha' 'gro dang*/ 'byung po rnams kyi snying gar phog pas rang dbang med par dbang du bsdus shing zil gyis mnan par bsam la/ e myags ya brngubs mug shaka ka dun hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces/ e myags nga ro 'brug ltar sgrog /slar yang slob dpon bdag nyid zil gnon chen por gsal ba'i sku las khro bo grangs med pas khams gsum me yi 'khor lo rab tu 'khrugs pa dang bcas pas dur khrod kyi sha za mkha' 'gro mas/ bam chen gyi ro la dbang byed pa de thams cad zil gyis mnan te brgyal ba dang*/ rengs pa dang*/ rmongs par byas par bsam/ thams cad dgyes pa'i gar dang ldan// hur gyis blangs nas lan gsum du// dkyil 'khor bskor nas byang du e// thal chen gyis bris steng du bzhag de dag ni nub dang po'i bya ba'o// de nas lhag gnas kyi rim pa la// dkyil 'khor rdzas bum lha dang ni// slob ma bam gyi sta gon ston// rgyal chen bka' bsgo phyi mtshams bcad// dam sri mnan cing sgo byang gdags// ma traṃ bsgral dang thig tshon las// dkyil 'khor sta gon dag la 'dod/

dai yang*/ slob dpon sogs kyis bdag bskyed bzlas pa bshags pa'i bar las byang bzhin sngon du 'gro bas// sgrub khang phyi ru rgyal chen sde bzhi'i sku dang sngags byang bcas pa'i tho bzhi btsugs// de mdun mchod dang gtor ma bshams// bdud rtsis sbyangs nas 'di skad brjod/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bh+rūm̐ pho brang spos ngad ldan nang hūm̐ yig las// rgyal po chen po yul bsrung sku mdog dkar// brjid cing rgyan gyis spras pa rgyud mangs sbreng*// dri za'i sde la dbang bsgyur 'khor gyis bskor// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ri rab kyi shar phyogs nas rgyal po chen po yul 'khor bsrung 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsam la/ hūm̐ yul 'khor bsrung ni shar phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal// btsun mo sras bcas blon po gnyen 'dun dang*// mdza' bshes nang mi dmag gi dpung bcas pa// dad pas spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdam tshig pa dang gnyis med bstim// hūm̐ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar skyes pa'i// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod pa 'di// rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag gi 'phrin las sgrubs// oṃ ma hā rā dza ḍhṛṣ+ṭa raṣ+ṭa sa pa ri wā re ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā// nyer spyod lnga bya gtor ma ni/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rā dza ḍhṛṣ+ṭa raṣ+ṭa sa pa ri wā ra ba ling+ta khā hi/ lan gsum gyis phul/ hūm̐ shar phyogs nas ni yul 'khor bsrung*// 'jig rten skyong ba gzi brjid ldan// rdzu 'phrul che la stobs po che// khyod la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du brtan par bzhugs la/ dgra bgegs nang du mi btang zhing bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ de bzhin lho nas rim pa bzhin// rigs bsgres nas ni 'di lta bu/

bsangs sbyangs snga ma ltar/ /bh+rūm̐ pho brang bai ḍūr+ya nang hūm̐ yig las// rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes sku mdog sngo// brjid cing rgyan gyis spras pa ral gri 'phyar// grul bum sde la dbang bsgyur 'khor gyis bskor/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ri rab kyi lho phyogs nas rgyal po chen po 'phags skyes po 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsam la/ /hūm̐ 'phags par skyes ni lho phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal// btsun mo sras bcas blon po gnyen 'dun dang*// mdza' bshes nang mi dmag gi dpung bcas pa// dad pas spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis med bstim// hūm̐

/gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar skyes pa'i// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod pa 'di// rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag gi phrin las sgrubs// oṃ ma hā rā dza bi rū dha ka sa pa ri wā re ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes nyer spyod lnga bya gtor ma ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rā dza bi rū dha ka sa pa ri wā ra ba ling+ta khā hi/ lan gsum gyis phul/ hūm̐ lho phyogs nas ni 'phags skyes po// 'jig rten skyong ba gzi brjid ldan// rdzu 'phrul che la stobs po che// khyod la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du brtan par bzhugs la/ dgra bgegs nang du mi gtong zhing bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /t-iṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ nub nas mchod gtor bsangs sbyangs la/ bh+rūm̐ pho brang rgya mtsho'i dpal nang hūm̐ yig las// rgyal po chen po lus ngan sku mdog dmar// brjid cing rgyan gyis spras pa sbrul zhags 'phen// klu dbang sde la dbang bsgyur 'khor gyis bskor// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ri rab kyi nub phyogs nas rgyal po chen po spyan mi bzang 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsam la/ hūm̐ sna tshogs gzugs ni nub phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal// btsun mo sras bcas blon po gnyen 'dun dang*// mdza' bshes nang mi dmag gi dpung bcas pa// dad pas spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis med bstim/ hūm̐ /gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar skyes pa'i// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod pa 'di// rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag gi phrin las sgrubs// oṃ ma hā rā dza bi rū pāk+ṣa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nyer spyod lngas mchod gtor ma ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rā dza bi rū pāk+ṣa sa pa ri wā ra ba ling+ta khā hi/

lan gsum gyis phul/ hūm̐ nub phyogs nas ni spyan mi bzang*// 'jig rten skyong ba gzi brjid ldan// rdzu 'phrul che la stobs po che// khyod la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du brtan par bzhugs la/ dgra bgegs nang du mi gtong zhing bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ dngos grub sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /t-iṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ byang nas mchod gtor bsangs sbyang la/ bh+rūm̐ pho brang lcang lo can nang hūm̐ yig las// rgyal po chen po rnam sras sku mdog ljang*// brjid cing rgyan gyis spras pa rgyal mtshan 'phyar// gnod sbyin sde la dbang bsgyur 'khor gyis bskor// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ri rab kyi byang phyogs nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsam la/ hūm̐ ro ldan gnas nas byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal// btsun mo sras bcas blon po gnyen 'dun dang*// mdza' bshes nang mi dmag gi dpung bcas pa// dad pas spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis med bstim/ hūm̐ gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar skyes pa'i// lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod pa 'di// rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag gi phrin las sgrubs// oṃ ma hā rā dza bai shrā ma ṇa ya sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swā hā/ nyer spyod lngas mchod gtor ma ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rā dza bai shrā ma ṇa sa pa ri wā ra ba ling+ta khā hi/ lan gsum gyis phul/ hūm̐ byang phyogs nas ni rnam thos sras// 'jig rten skyong ba gzi brjid ldan// rdzu 'phrul che la stobs po che// khyod la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du brtan par bzhugs la/ dgra bgegs nang du mi gtong zhing bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/

dngos grub sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /t-iṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ rten de rnams la rgyal po chen po mthu rtsal can rnams bzhugs nas mtshams kyi phrin las mdzad par bsams/ sgrub pa ma grol gyi bar nangs re bzhin mchod bstod phrin bcol bya'o// de nas/ sngar bzhin khro bcus phyi mtshams bcad/ ces pas slar yang phur bu rnams khrobacur gsal btab la/ hūm̐ steng du khro rgyal hūm̐ kā ra// dbu gsum phyag drug mtshon cha 'phen// sku smad phur bu 'bar ba'i dbal// tshangs pa'i 'khor tshogs mtshams chod cig /oṃ ma hā kro dha hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces kun la 'gre ba'i bsgyur ka shes pas/ sa bdag 'khor tshogs mtshams chod cig /oṃ ma hā kro dha ma hā bā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa'i bar ro// dam sri mnan pa 'di lta bu// shog bur g.yas rta g.yon khyi dang*// mi mgo gsum can liṅga bca'// snying gar dzaḥganyis sprad dbus tri// steng g.yas mdun g.yon kha sprod par/ trig nan u nan/ e hur/ breng shag rbad thum dzaḥ snyab pa lag ring tri dzaḥstam+bha ya nan/ rgyal po the'u rang tri dzaḥstam+bha ya nan/ oṃ sum bha ni sogs// dam sri 'gong po bsen mo yul 'dre 'khyams po stam+bha ya nan/ lus kyi mthar bskor gshin bltab byas/ dug shog la lag len ltar bris par/ sbyang khrus byas nas/ khug rtags ma byung bar 'gug sngags kyis bkug nas lha dbye byas rjes gshin bltab byas la/ skud nag rgya gram bcings nas su// kham sa yos tshig ling snying bcug /liṅga de nyid kham sa dang yos tshig gi phye mas nya bo mdzub gang bzos pa'i snying gar gzhug /brub khung nya'u bskyed bden pa bdar/ pho nya bskul dgug bstim sri sbyang*/ zhes pas sgrub khang gi phyi rol sgo drung du brub khung khru gang brkos par tshig gzugs bcug nas/ phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang*// sogs gser skyems btang*/ bka' drin 'khor med rdo rje slob dpon dang*/

sogs gzu dpang gzug la/ e las brub khung 'di nyid gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom sogs kyis brub khung dang nya'u bskyed nas bden pa brdar la 'gug gzhug gzhung bzhin gyi/ gzugs med gnod par byed pa bgegs thams cad dang*/ khyad par du dngos grub sgrub par byed pa la bar du gcod pa'i dam sri phung sri 'byung po'i rigs su gyur pa thams cad skad cig yud cig la dmigs pa'i nya'u 'di la sogs/ lan gsum/ hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings nas 'jam dpal he ru ka / sogs kyis pho nya bskul/ a+ye ring gi sham bur/ dam sri ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ sogs gzhung bzhin btags pas dgug /a we sha ya a zhes bstim nas/ sri sbyang ba ni/ /hūm̐ dam sri bya ba'i sdig can khyod// dug gsum nyon mongs dbang du song*// gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyan po bshig /dkon mchog gsum gyi sku dgrar gyur// pho nya lcags kyus mi 'gugs su// ngan song gnas su 'khyams la dga'// rgyab brten dbang du mi bsdu ru// sdig pa'i grogs pos gtong ma phod// phyag rgya dra bas mi bcing du// khyod kyi lus sems sdod ma nyan// liṅga'i rten la mi bstim du// bag chags ngan par rten ma byung*// rnon po rtsang gis mi bskor du// dam sri phung sri 'gros la dga'// ye shes phur pas mi 'debs su// ngan song gnas su gzhol la dga'// shes rab ral gris mi gtub tu// gti mug mun par 'khyams par 'gyur// thun rdzas rnams kyis mi brab tu// lus sems rdul du 'gro ma nyan// dug chu khol mas mi sbyang du// ye nas nyon mongs dug gis gzir// khro bo'i zhal du mi btab tu// gzugs phung sha khrag rul ba'i rgyu// de nas bka' la mi gdags su// phyin chad ngan spyod dgag par byed// phur bskyed nas gzung brab rdzogs pa/ hūm̐ bdag ni 'jam dpal he ru ka / sogs nas mtshon cha brdeg pa'i bar gyi thun yongs rdzogs song nas// them 'og dong brus mnan nas su// sa chu me ni rim dgus mnan/

dam sri'i rnam smin lus rten spyi'u tshugs su mnan la/ ro g.yam stong khams bris pas bkab cing*/ laṃ laṃ laṃ stam+bha ya nan/ zhes sa rim pa gsum dang*/ baṃ baṃ baṃ stam+bha ya nan/ zhes chu rim pa gsum dang*/ raṃ raṃ raṃ stam+bha ya nan/ zhes me rim pa gsum ste 'byung ba rim dgus mnan// las kyi gshin rje dag la gtad/ /hūm̐ 'byung ba rten gzhi'i rngams 'og nas// las kyi tshe bdag nag po ni// ya mtshan chen po rmad du byung*// mun nag 'thibs pa'i nang du bzhugs// g.yas pa'i lag na ri rab thogs// g.yon pa'i lag na rgya mtsho 'khrug /zhabs kyis rlung gi 'khor lo mnan// dam nyams las kyi dam sri la// mnan pa las kyi dus la bab// sgo med lcags khang nang du chug /gshin rje rnams kyi zas su byin// 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs la bskyon// rgya mtsho chen po'i gting du chug /ri rab chen po'i rmang du non// nam yang gtong bar ma byed cig /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pas 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi sgrub pa byed pa la bar du gcod pa'i dam sri 'phung sri 'byung po rgyal bsen gson 'dre gshin 'dre thams cad mā ra ya stam+bha ya nan/ dong gi kha mi mngon par bkab la/ hūm̐ stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten na/ sogs/ 'phrin las bzhin du bro brdung ngo*// ya them phyir ni gshin rje'i gzugs/ kha phyir bstan pa'i mdun du// mchod dang gtor ma bshams nas su/ bsang sbyangs byas la/ /hūm̐ pho brang thod pa lcags mkhar hūm̐ yig las// gshin rje'i rgyal po mthing nag ma he'i gdong*// dur khrod chas brgyan thod dbyug 'khor lo bskor// dregs pa'i sde la dbang bsgyur ma he brdzis// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ya ma rā tsa ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ya ma rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ya ma rā dza ba ling+ta khā hi/ zhes pas/ nyer mchod gtor ma phul nas su/ /hūm̐ srid pa'i lha srin 'byung po kun// khyed kyi 'khor dang g.yog lags kyi// rnam par smin pa'i chos shod la// sa 'di yan la bgegs ma btang*// ya ma rā tsa sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/

nang log bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i gzugs/ zhal nang du bstan pa'i mdun du mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams nas/ bsang sbyangs byas la/ /hūm̐ las kyi khro bo sku mdog ljang*// bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya yis// rgya gram dril bu 'dzin mdzad pa// g.yon brkyang klu chen brgyad kyis brgyan// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra a mṛta kuṇ+ḍa li ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ba ling+ta khā hi/ zhes pas/ mchod dang gtor ma phul nas su/ /hūm̐ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa ni// rdo rje khro bo'i skur bstan pa// bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal bstod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil bas nang gi dngos grub phyir mi gtong ba'i phrin las mdzod cig / 'dod pa'i don gsol nang log nas// stegs bu khyab pa ru dra'i gzugs// gdong gsum lag drug rkang bzhi bris// bden stobs pho nya bskul dang dgug zhes pas slob dpon 'jam dpal gshin rje'i nga rgyal dang bcas/ na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka'= dge 'dun gyi bka'= khro bo'i rgyal po 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po phyag rgya zil gyis gnon pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi bka'= bden pa chen po 'di yi byin gyis brlabs kyis/ rnam pa ma traṃ ru tra ngo bo dngos grub la bar du gcod pa'i bdud dang log 'dren thams cad skad cig yud cig la dmigs pa'i rten ma traṃ gi gzugs 'di la lcags kyu can rnams kyis khug cig /zhags pa can rnams kyis chings shig /lcags sgrog can rnams kyis sdoms shig /dril bu can rnams gyis myos shig / lan gsum byas nas pho nya bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings nas 'jam dpal he ru ka / sogs dang dgug pa a+ye ring sham bu 'di/ /ma traṃ ru tra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ

ma traṃ dra ā yur+dzñā na ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ ma traṃ ru dra tri yaṃ ni ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ ma traṃ ru dra rū pa skan+dha ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥdzaḥ pra we sha ya phaṭa/ ces brjod/ /hūm̐ ma traṃ zhes brjod ru dra khyod// thub dka'i drung du dam log byas// sngon yang sgrub la bar du bcad// dngos grub kun la rab tu bsgribs// de tshe 'jam dpal gshin rje yis// thugs rje thabs kyis bzung nas su// ma 'gags rol pa'i tho bas bcom// bsgral nas dur khrod rgyan du byas// khungs dang rtsad bcad bdag las phyung*// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i ru dra 'di// bdag med spros bral dbyings su bsgral// de ring rgyal ba'i rjes su 'jug /oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ ma traṃ ru dra dzaḥ ā kar+ṣa ru dra dzaḥ kha traṃ ka ru dra dzaḥ ru dra kha tra mā ra ya rbad/ ces brjod pas bsgral nas/ khog pa gzhal yas khang yan lag /dur khrod bsams nas thig gi rgyu// rgyu ma'i nang shun nam dar skud lnga// gang rung bhan+dhar bdud rtsis bran// zil gnon yab yum sbyor mtshams kyi// sems bstim ye shes lnga ru bsam/ slob dpon nub dang thig g.yog pa shar du 'khod de/ slob dpon bdag nyid 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros/ slob ma la phog /sdig sgrib dang rnam smin gyi lus bsreg sbyangs/ yum pe ta li'i skur gyur pa'i yab kyi gnas lngar rnam snang sogs rigs kyi yab lnga dang*/ yum gyi gnas lngar spyan ma sogs rigs kyi yum lnga gsal ba'i yab yum rnams gnyis med mnyam sbyor gyis snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can sbyor mtshams su lhung ba srad bu la thim pas ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin du gyur par bsam la// ye thig bla ma yab gsal bas// thugs nas ye shes lnga yi skud// 'ja' tshon 'drar 'thon gzungs ma ni// yum gsal bha gar thim nas slar// thugs las thon bsam thig bskor bas/

zhes pa/ slob dpon zil gnon gyi skur gsal ba'i thugs ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid/ rnam pa ye shes kyi thig skud 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i skud pa lta bur thugs ka nas thon te yum gyi bha ga nas zhugs pa slar yang de nyid kyi thugs ka nas tshur thon/ phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rgyal sras zhi khro rab 'byams ma lus pa'i thugs bde ba chen po ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin can kun kyang 'od zer sna lnga'i tshul du de nyid la thim par gyur bsam nas thig skud nam mkhar 'then te/ hūm̐ stong gsum dmigs bcas yum gyi gzhal yas su// thugs rje 'gyur med yab kyi thig btab pas// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med byang chub sems// rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dal ni mkha' la gsal// oṃ dzñā na maṇ+ḍa la mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ tshangs thig brgyad dang logs thig mkhar// nam mkha' thams cad gzhal yas khang*// rgyal rnams zil gnon lha tshogs bsam/ tshangs thig sogs thig re gdab pa dang bstun gong gi sngags de nyid tshar re brjod/ de nas dam tshig gi thig dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi la ji ltar 'debs pa'i tshul ni// ye shes thig zer dam tshig thig /thig chen brgyad btab ran gru bzhi// tshangs gnyis rgyab mdun brgyad brgyad gsil// de 'dra cha gcig kun la bsnan// dang po phyed btab phyi ma gshag /gnyis bzhi drug pa'i mtha' gnyis gsil// bdun pa dang po brgyad gnyis bzhin// dgu phyed dbus nas cha gsum bzhi// bskor zhing gnyis kar phran bzas yang*// phyi cha bzhi gsil gru gsum bgod// zlum nang gru gsum lte gling dgu// gru gsum bsnol rtse bar gshags rtsibs// drug thal mu ran nang bcur bgo /mda' yab sgo 'dzom drug bskor gnyis// bskyed cing de steng gcig phyin rwa// gsum dbus gnyis bskor 'og nas re// glang rgyab dgu phyed bum bre yan// gcig gnyis gsum gcig gsum zlum bskor// rtsibs steng gru dang 'obs dag gi

/phyogs mtshams mu ran la drug cu// gru gsum pa ste tshon lngar hūm̐// khrag 'thung lngar bsam ye shes bstim// 'od zhu rin chen phye mar song*/ tshon lnga snod so sor blug pa la hūm̐ kha dog lnga bris pa phyogs bzhi dbus lngar bkod/ nyer spyod kyis bskor/ bsangs sbyangs/

tshon rnams mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ kha dog lnga yongs su gyur pa las khrag 'thung rigs lnga yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur pa'i gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang*/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bstim zhing*/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra ar+ghaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ sogs kyis mchod/ mi rtog rdo rje sogs kyi tshig tha ma/ khrag 'thung rigs lnga'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod la/ lha rnams 'od du zhu ba rin po che'i phye ma'i rnam par gyur par bsam/ /lag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i// mtheb mdzub thabs shes shes pas bri// gling nang ljang la gru gsum mthing*// zla gam dmar la 'khor lo sngo// rtsibs mchan dmar po gru chad mthing*// khyams ni phyogs mdog rtsig par lnga// nang du thod pa lcags tshon gcig /snam bu dmar po ba gam ser// mun pa nag la shar bu sngo// mda' dkar khyams dmar phyi nang gi /mu khyud thams cad lcags kha la// thod pa'i ri mos mdzes par bskor// ka ba phyogs mdog rgyan rta babs// ci mdzes dag tu bya ba yin// sta gon gnyis pa rten dang rgyan// dbang dang mchod pa'i rdzas bsham pa// rgyal bram rje dmangs thod tshal la// gtso rtsa gyad sprul las gshin gzugs/ pho mo'i thod par zil gnon yab yum gyi sku man ngag dang ldan pa'i phyag len bzhin bris pa kha sbyar dang*/ rtsa ba'i lha rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byang bu sogs rten rnams tshad ldan du bcas pa la// 'dzb byang phyag rgya rab gnas byas/ /hūm̐ longs spyod grub pa'i rdzas mchog dam pa 'di// 'khor ba ma spangs lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir// bka' gsang bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po la// dur khrod rdzas kyi longs spyod bkram par bgyi// zhes brjod byang bu gnyis btags pa'i// mda' phur dbus bzhag phyogs su phur// mtshams mda' zla gam ral gri dang*// rtsig grur seng ldeng be con te// 'obs khang so gnyis khram shing dang*// sgo phur mu ran rtsangs dmar ro/

dkyil 'khor gyi steng lding khri'i dbus su thod sku kha sbyor dang*/ gtso bo'i phyag mtshan dang sngags byang gi byang bu gnyis btags pa'i mda' dang phur bu khrag chen gyis byugs pa bzhag /phyag rdor sogs rtsa lha bzhi'i gnas phyogs bzhir byang bu btags pa'i phur bu bzhi/ mtshams bzhir gyad gnon gyi byang bu bcas pa'i mda'/ zla gam gsum la las gshin gyi byang bu btags pa'i mi bsad kyi ral gri re rnams dang*/ rtsibs bcu gnyis kyi lo gshed dang gru chad kyi zla gshed rnams la so sor seng ldeng gi be con re/ 'obs khang so gnyis zhag gshed kyi gnas su khram shing so gnyis/ sgo bzhi'i khro rgyal bzhi'i gnas su phur bu bzhi dang*/ mu ran la rtsang dmar drug cu/ de'i phyir sngar gyi khro bcu'i phur pa rnams dgod par bya/ /zhing chen bla bre zhing sogs kyi// rgyal mtshan sna tshogs go rmog dang*// mtshon cha rgyu ma'i drwa ba la// nang khrol kun gyi drwa phyed can// mda' dar lhab lhub phye phur sogs// rngam zhing zhud pa'i spyan gzigs sbrel/ de nas dbang rdzas dgram pa ni// mig dar me tog 'phreng ba dang*// maṇ+ḍal lha tsaka phyag mtshan dang*// dbu rgyan dar dpyangs rdo rje dril// bum pa'i dbang rdzas shar du'o// bdud rtsi lnga dang sgron ma lnga/ dngos sam zan la gzugs brnyan bcos pa/ /bhan+dha'i nang du bshams pa dang*// dpal gyi chas brgyad bkra shis bum/ thabs shes nyi zla ga'u kha sbyor gyi tshe gal/ /'brang rgyas sha zas tshe dbang gi /rak+ta gtor ma lcags mkhar mar grags pa chos 'byung bsnol ma'i gdan can 'khor gsum dang bcas pa'o tshogs 'khor lo/ gsang ba'i dbang rdzas lho ru'o// rigs lnga las byung rig ma ni// bcu gcig ma nas nyer lnga'i bar// gsum pa'i rdzas nub bam ni byang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi mdun du gtor ma dbus la sman ni g.yas// rak+ta g.yon du mchod pa'i rdzas// ji snyed pa dang rol mo bsham/

byang du bzlog pa'i gtor chen ni ru sbal khog gam sla nga'i nang*// 'bru nag khrag sbrus bang rim lnga// steng du bshos bu zur gsum pa// seng can zhal btod bang rim la// lha grangs mnyams pa'i bshos zur gsum// gnam sa chu la rgyu dgu'i gzugs// ngar glud khram byang rtsangs yungs kar// rgyu drwa snying sha mar gyis brgyan// dpal gyi gtor ma chen por bshad// bzlog bsad ma traṃ gzugs su bya/ gang la bzlog gsad bya ba'i yul nya'u dang dkar byang*/ /gdug pa sa yi brub khung dang*// gdab pa'i thun dang nya'u ni/ dkar byang dmar byang gang yin kyang 'dra ste go rim ma nor bar bya dgos pa ste lte mgo yan lag bya rim bzhin// srid dang rnam shes srog chags sam// snying gar nṛ bris dngos 'dra ba// che ge mo rak+ṣa dzaḥdzaḥ dmigs rten la khrag chags par bsam/ de bzhin du/ raṃ rak+ṣa dzaḥdzaḥ drod māṃ rak+ṣa dbugs/ dzaḥdzaḥ sha rak+ṣa dzaḥ sha/ dzaḥ keṃ rak+ṣa rus/ dzaḥdzaḥ tsit+ta sems rak+ṣa dzaḥdzaḥ ti ra rak+ṣa dzaḥdzaḥ de la khrag drod dbugs sha rus// sems chags dgra bo dngos su bsam// shar mchod sman raka bar gyi mchod gtor lhor bshags gtor nub tu bskang gtor // byang bzlog thun gtor mtshams su nya'u bsgral bsgral chas / ༈ de nas bum pa sta gon ni/ rgyu bca' lha bskyed spyan drangs bstim// phyag mchod bstod pa 'dzb kyi las// gser dang dngul sogs rin chen bum/ lha yi grangs sam gnyis kyi yang*// rnam par rgyal bar lha kun te// las bum bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'o// mtshan ldan legs bkrus spos kyis bdugs/ /oṃ slob ma ji snyed pa'i byang mgul btags mgul kha brgyan/ lnga tshan lnga dang chu yis dgang*// rdo rje gzungs thag btags la bkod// byang shar mtshams su stegs bcas bzhag /gu gul gyis bdug yungs bas brabs/ /swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las muṃ mthing nag

/'od 'phros don gnyis byas 'dus thim// tri shū lar gyur oṃ āḥhūm̐/ pe ta li rak+ṣa sa masta hūm̐// sbyor ba'i yum gyur bha gar bh+rūṃ// yongs su gyur pas phyi bum pa// nang ni dur khrod gzhal yas khang*// chu dang 'o ma lha yi gdan/ /rdzas ni a kro te kas te/ zhes pa/ rdzas yungs dkar la dmigs nas/ bskyed sngags/ oṃ a kro te ka ya man+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces brgya rtsa'am nyer gcig bzlas la bum par blug pa'i rkyen gyis/ bum pa'i nang du skad cig gis/ bcom ldan dpal chen phyag rgya zil gnon sku/ sogs nas/ bshan pa khrag skyugs dregs pa kun gyis bskor/ zhes pa'i bar/ mngon rtogs 'phrin las bzhin du bya/ /las bum khro bo sku mdog ljang*// bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i phyag rgya yis// rgya gram dril bu 'dzin mdzad pa/ g.yon brkyang klu chen brgyad kyis brgyan// ces las bum sgo byang bzhin du bskyed// spyan drangs nas gzung 'dzb kyi bar/ hūm̐ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa'i sku/ zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas bstan srung mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pa'i bar las byang dkyus ltar dang*/ las lha'i bstod pa/ hūm̐ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mthu stobs gcig tu bsdus pa yi// rdo rje khro bo'i skur ston pa// bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal bstod// de nas gsol 'debs dang dzb bro byas la/ slob dpon gyis gzungs thag la 'jus te/ sngags 'phreng 'od kyis bde gshegs rnams// zil gnon yab yum rnam par byon// nam mkha' gang ba'i sbyor mtshams rgyun// rang gi spyir thim snying nang nas// 'od kyi zer thag la 'jus te// bum pa'i lhar thim de yum gyi// bha ga brgyud pas bum pa gang*/ ces bsgom bzhin pas/ sku gsung thugs kyi snying po dang*/ a+ye ring bzla/ gzungs thag las bum khar spos la/ /'khyil ba'i gsang ba nas bdud rtsi// rdo rje phra mo'i rdul du byon/

bum pa yongs su gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ phaṭ/ nyer gcig tsam bzla// bum khengs mthar ni lha rnams kyang*// bdud rtsi'i rnam par de la thim/ mthar lha rnams kyang bdud rtsi'i rnam par zhu nas bum chu dang gnyis med ro gcig tu gyur par mos/ ༈ lha yi sta gon dkyil 'khor la// dmigs pas mtshams bcad nas gzung ste// bstod pa'i bar yin dkyil 'khor lha// mngon sum lta bur bzhugs gyur pa// stobs nus phun sum tshogs par bsams/ zhes pas/ rdul tshon nam ras bris gang yin gyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs te/ hūm̐ gshin rje gshed po khros pa'i me// zhes pa nas bstod pa rdzogs pa'i bar dkyus ltar ro/ ༈ slob ma sta gon ni/ de nas yol bas der bcad la// khrus bskrad gsol drang phyag rgya gsol// spro bskyed nyan gdams sems gnyis sdom// sgrib bsal byin rlabs so shing dang*// khyor chu ku sha bsrung chos bshad// rmi lam brtag pa slob ma'i 'o// rdo rje rgyal po dgongs par bzhugs// rdo rje las mkhan chas zhugs nas// phyir phyin slob ma ji snyed pa// khrus byas bgegs gtor byin brlabs byin/ /hūm̐ yang gsang lha zhes sogs brjod cing gu gul bdug /thun brab mtshams bcad bzhi ka bya/ der rjes sgo ba la/ /hūm̐ mi shes 'khor bar 'khyams bsgral te// theg pa chen por 'god pa'i phyir// dpa' bo chen po dpa' byad can// ye shes sgo 'di bdag la phye// sgo bas phye nas las mkhan gyi// rdo rje la bzung chig sbreng khrid/ /hūm̐ 'bras bu rdo rje gsang ba'i lam// 'di ni theg chen bla na med// gzungs 'phreng rdo rje 'di la 'jus// thar pa'i lam mchog 'di la shog / yol ba'i rtsar bzhag phyag byas te/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ /ho ston pa'i sgron ma bcom ldan 'das// lha dang slob dpon dgongs su gsol// dregs pa'i stobs kyi tshul bstan pa'i// brtul zhugs dam pa bdag la stsol//

lan gsum gsol btab bla ma yis/ /spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyod pas rnam par phye ba ni gsum ste/ bden pa dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi spyod pa la brten pa yin no// rgyud las/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang*// de bzhin gang dag ma byon pa// da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// de dag kun gyis gsang sngags kyi// cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen pas// dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du// thams cad mkhyen pa tshad med brnyes// gsang sngags sbyor ba mnyam med des// skyob pa shākya seng ge yis// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i// dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom// zhes gsungs so// gsang sngags kyi spyod pa yang*/ rnam pa bzhi ste/ bya ba dang*/ spyod pa dang*/ rnal 'byor dang*/ rnal 'byor bla med do// rnal 'byor bla med la yang*/ ma hā yo ga /a nu yo ga /a ti yo ga gsum du yod pa las// 'di rdzogs pa chen po a ti ltar nyams su len pa 'di la yang dmod pa'i las rnam pa gsum las drag sngags gnam thog chen po'i sbyor ba/ de la yang las kyi mtha' tshe bdag 'chi bdag srog bdag gsum las 'di tshe bdag /de yang lhun gyis grub pa'i tshe bdag /phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i tshe bdag /phyag rgya gcig pa'i tshe bdag /sprul pa'i tshe bdag /las kyi tshe bdag lngar yod pa las/ 'di phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i tshe bdag ces bya ba yin no// spro ba bskyed nas nyan par gdams/ /rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni// shin tu bsam pa bzang po ldan pas nyon// brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems sogs pa// bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob// de nas thun mong sems bskyed ni/ /dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// sogs so thun mong ma yin pa/ /gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor cher/ gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir/ sogs nas/ a drā u pa da ya mi/

zhes pa'i bar dang*// rigs lnga'i sdom pa 'di yis blang*/ /rnam rtog ye shes lngar gyur pas// rtag tu brten cing spyad par bya// rgyal ba rigs lnga'i brtul zhugs dag /srog gi phyir yang mi btang ngo*/ de nas oṃ ya mān+ta ka sa mā ya ma nu pā la ya sogs/ yig brgya lan 'gas slob ma'i sgrib// sbyangs nas zil gnon du bskyed la/ slob ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las klu 'bum gnyan khri sogs a+ye ring bsnyen pa'i man ngag ltar/ 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i klong na bzhugs par gyur ces pa'i bar ro// gnas gsum dri yi thig le byas/ /na maḥsarba thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ de bzhin wā ka tsit+ta bcug so shing las chus bsangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ bdun phrag tsam bzlas byin gyis brlab la// tshom bu lnga pa'i maṇ+ḍal te/ tshom bu 'di nyid rgyal ba rigs lnga'i rang bzhin du shes pas/ me tog 'phreng bcings so shing gi /rtsa ba so la drud pas su/ /badz+ra hā sa ha/ 'don pas dor la dbus zug mchog /shar lho nub byang zhi rgyas dbang*// drag po mtshams ni thun mong ba// steng 'og mkha' spyod sa spyod grub/ dri bzang gi chu la sngags kyis bsangs// de nas dri chu khyor bar blug /oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥsarba dharma sarba pā pā ni tsā s+ya bi shwa dha ya sarba bi kalpān a pa nā ya hūm̐/ lan bdun bzlas te sbyin// hub gsum lhag ma rgyab tu gtor/ ku sha bsangs/ badz+ra tik+ṣ+ṇa baṃ/ lan bdun bzlas pas bzlas pas sngas dang stan du byin// skud pa sngo dmar lus tshad pa// gsum dril rdo rje'i mdud gsum brtsegs/ las chus bsang*/ e myags ya brngubs mug shag ka dun hūm̐ phaṭ/ nyer gcig bzlas pa'i phus btab nas/ /e myags sngags btab skyes pa'i g.yon// bud med g.yas la dri rdo rjes/ slar yang*// e myags ya brngubs mug shag ka dun// zhes brjod bsrungs nas chos bshad pa/

/'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen rnams// u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis sems can mnyam med don// mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus// de nas rmi lam brtag pa'i phyir/ bzhin bzang dag bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs su mgo ston la dregs pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang zhu ba la mos gus chen pos nyol la dngos grub kyi mtshan ma bzang ngan rmi lam du rtogs shig / ces bya dkyil 'khor khang der nyal// sta gon drug pa baṃ la ni// bdug bskrad khrus bsang brgyan snying thag /bskon bcug mnan brlab slob ma'i bzhin// gu gul gyis bdug bgegs bskrad la// rnam bum gyis khrus las kyis bsang*// gser g.yu dar brgyan snying thag ni/ skud pa dkar dmar gnyis bsgril byas pa nyid/ /dkar dmar byang sems gnyis bsam bsgril/ /hūm̐ nyon cig ti ra mchog chen khyod// thabs kyi spyod pas 'gro don du// bdag gi chas su gzhug par bgyi// ngan song gsum du lhung dogs nas// snying thag dkar dmar rtod du mnan// mtha' yas rlung gis mi spur ro// thugs rje rgyun gyi thag pas btags//

baṃ btags phur par rtod la mnan/ thag pa'i sne mo phur pas gtod la mnan nas mchod pa bshams la/ phur pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ ya ma smug po 'khor lo tsit+ta bsnams// drag shul che la dpal gyi chas brgyad 'chang*// g.yon brkyang 'bar ba'i dbus na brjid par 'gyings// dam tshig ye shes dbyer med ngo bor gyur// ya ma rā dza badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ hūm̐ smug nag 'jig rten kun gyi gshed// log lta sbyor ba'i stobs kyis gnon// 'khor ba'i tsit+ta'i phreng ba bsnams// ya ma rā dzar phyag 'tshal bstod// su pra tiṣ+ṭha= / brtan bzhugs bya// phur pa sras mchog ya ma rar// mnga' gsol nyi zla gza' skar tsaka /hūm̐ lha srin sde brgyad zil gyis gnon slad du// nyi zla gza' skar bris pa mgo la bskon// zhes bskon snying po gsum bris pa/ oṃ e ka ya ma he dun rak+sha dun dun dza ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ āḥ.e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ hūm̐ e myags ya rngubs mug shak+ka dun hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces gser la sogs pas bris la/ /hūm̐ mthu rtsal byin rlabs chen po 'byung ba'i phyir// yig 'bru snying po bris pa zhal du gzhug / khar bcug dgra ling 'og tu mnan/ dgra bgegs kyi liṅga bris par las gzhung bzhin 'gug bstim byas la/ /hūm̐ bdud dang log 'dren ma lus tshar bcad phyir// dgra bgegs dgug bstim liṅga 'og tu gzhug / gnas gsum dri thig byin rlabs sngags/ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de bzhin kā ya'i tshab tu wāk+ka dang tsit+ta bcug pas bam chen gyi gnas gsum du bdud rtsi'i thig le bkod cing*// sngar bzhin brjod nas 'di skad bsgo/ /hūm̐ nyon cig ti ra baṃ chen khyod// bdud dang rtsal 'gran ma byed cig /sde brgyad ru shags ma 'gyed cig /btsan dang ru 'gran ma byed cig /dmu dang cho lo ma rtse cig /ho ston pa'i sgron me bcom ldan 'das//

sogs/ gsol btab yol ba'i phyir drang man/ slob ma lhag gnas la byed kun// baṃ la'ang bya ba shes par bya/ ༈ /dkyil 'khor bzhi ste rdul tshon dang*// lus dang bha ga baṃ chen po/ de dag sta gon rim bzhin bya ba'i phyir/ dang po/ /bris pa rdul tshon nam ras bris phyag rgyar dbang gsum pa'i rten bcas pa dang*// rdo rje slob dpon mchog gi sku/ dkyil 'khor gsum po thun mong la dmigs nas/ las bum gyi/ bdud rtsis bsangs te mtshams bcad nas// 'dzb bar lhan cig gyer nas su// bzlas pa lugs bzhin byas pa'i mthar// sku sngags phyag rgya bum cod pan// rdor dril rigs lngar bsgoms byas nas// ye shes spyan drangs dbang bskur bstim/ bum dbang gi rdzas de dag la dmigs te/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zil gnon badz+ra he ru ka mthing nag g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ yum rdo rje khros ma nam mkha' dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ zil gnon bud+dhā he ru ka smug nag g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon= yum khros ma sangs rgyas spyan ma dang= zil gnon rat+na he ru ka ser nag g.yas thod dbyug dang g.yon= yum khros ma mā ma ki dang= zil gnon pad+ma he ru ka dmar nag g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon= yum khros ma na bza' dkar mo dang= zil gnon karma he ru ka ljang nag g.yas ral gri dang g.yon= yum khros ma dam tshig sgrol ma dang= yum rnams tri shū la dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ de thams cad kyang dpal chen po'i chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang gis pad nyi ru dra'i steng du bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ gshegs ma rnams kyis dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/

mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa phul/ khro bo'i rgyal po dang khro mo rnams kyis bgegs skrod pa'i rnam pa du ma dang ldan pas/ ye nas sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// rdo rje 'chang rgyal spyi gzugs yin mod kyang*// ma rtogs sems can thugs rjes sgrol ba'i phyir/ khro bo rol pa'i nus mthu'i dbang bskur ro// oṃ hūm̐ swā aṃ hā a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ dbang bskur nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur// dam tshig bdud rtsi la sogs rdzas/ gsang dbang gi rdzas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum brjod cing*// yi ge gsum gyi sbyor bas sbyang*// slob dpon yab yum zil gnon bskyed/ bdag nyid skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i 'jam dpal he ru ka sogs e ring bsnyen pa'i man ngag gi bskyed chog ltar gyi 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i klong na bzhugs par gyur pa'i spyi bor zil gnon bud+dhā he ru ka yab yum/ mgrin par zil gnon pad+ma he ru ka yab yum/ thugs kar zil gnon badz+ra he ru ka yab yum/ lte bar zil gnon rat+na he ru ka yab yum/ gsang bar zil gnon karma he ru ka yab yum/ thams cad kyang g.yas pa rnams kyis rang rigs kyi phyag mtshan dang*/ g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ yum rnams tri shū la dang thod khrag 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba dpal chen po'i chas brgyad kyis brjid pa/ g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs par gyur// sa ma ya hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ/ badz+ra e a dza li hūm̐/ bde bskyed snyoms zhugs gnas lnga yi// khro bo lnga yang bde bas brgyal// rdo rje'i dbus nas snying kha'i bar// bde ba'i 'od kyis 'phags pa mchod// thams cad bde chen byang sems gyur// yab kyi zhal zhugs gnas lnga'i yang*// lha zhu yum gyi sbyor mtshams phab// de las phyir 'phros 'od lnga dang*// de nyid khrag 'thung rigs lnga po// yum bcas rol ba'i sbyor mtshams kyi// bdud rtsi dbang rdzas rnams la thim// dbang rdzas byang sems rang bzhin gyur// mdun gyi rigs lnga'ang de la bstim// lhag par tshe rdzas zil gnon lha// dmar po mnyam bzhag tshe bum can// thugs kar nṛ la e ring gsum// drag bzlas 'od kyis snod bcud bzhus// tshe lhar 'dus pa tshe yi lhas// nṛ+-i la dbang bskur bh+rūṃ gyis bsrung*// hūm̐ gis rdo rje'i drwa mig bsdams// a+ye a+ye a+ye ya ma nṛ bh+rūṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ dzaḥ

zhes ci nus bzla/ de nas dkyil 'khor chen po'i nub phyogs sa/ pad+ma rak+ta'i chos 'byung steng*// mtshan ldan gzungs ma dngos sam rig tsaka khrus byas bdugs// dri bzang lus dang bha gar byug /sbyor ba'i yum du bsgom du bcug /de yi bha ga gsang ba'i gnas// dkyil 'khor chen po rdzogs par bskyed// spyan drangs bzhugs gsol phyag bya mchod// bstod pa'i bar du legs par bya/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mūṃ mthing nag /'od 'phros don gnyis byas 'dus thim/ tri shū lar gyur oṃ āḥhūm̐/ pe ta li rak+sha sa masta hūm̐/ rig ma sbyor yum pe ta li mthing nag /snying bzung khrag gi mtsho brngubs gzig sham can// sku ni gtum sbeg dur khrod chas kyis brgyan// ral pa mun gtib rngams pa'i gar gyis rol// de yi bha gar bh+rūm̐ yig yongs gyur las// phyi bltas kun bzang rgyan bkod gzhal med khang*// gru bzhi sgo bzhi sogs nas bstod pa rdzogs pa'i bar las byang gzhung bzhin btang*// bshags byas slob dpon bdag 'jug tshang bar bya// baṃ la tshe dbang min pa'i dbang*/ slob ma la ji ltar bya ba bzhin rdzogs par bskur rjes de'i snying gar// bdud rtsi 'thor zhing thig le bkod// dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs snying gar bskyed// phung khams skye mched lha ru bsam/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ gyi phung po khams skye mched thams cad lhar dag pa'i snying gar dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bskyed pa'i phyir/ hūm̐ skye med rnam dag chos dbyings pho brang nas/ sogs las byang ltar lhar bsked cing*// spyan drangs bzhugs gsol phyag mchod bstod// lhag par e ring 'dzb kyi dus/ /nam mkhar dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma// thams cad sprin phung 'khrigs 'drar tshogs// dgyes pa'i gar dang bzhad pa'i glus// baṃ la me tog char 'bebs shing*// shis brjod mnga' gsol mdzad par

bsam// dngos su rol sgra spos dud sbyar// de nas tshogs bshams nas bzung ste// gdab pa'i bar du bya ba ste// de nas slob ma 'jug pa'i phyir/ /hūm̐ lhun grub rang bzhin gnas pa'i pho brang nas// ye shes rgya mtsho lhun gyis grub pa'i rtsal// 'jam dpal khros pa gshin rje gshed kyi lha// ma lus gnas pa'i rgyal po dgongs su gsol// slob ma mtshan ldan yum gyi dbang dal du// brtul zhugs drag po'i stobs kyis bzhugs su gsol// bde chen gsang ba'i pho brang dam pa ru// rig pa'i brtul zhugs stobs kyis bzhugs su gsol// lan gsum dkyil 'khor lha la gsol/ ༈ de nas dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dngos la// sgrub pa chen po dag la ni/ bla ma rdo rje rgyal po dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su 'khod pa'i mos pas phyogs ci bder bzhugs/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar du rdo rje rgyal thebs sogs phyogs so sor 'khod la/ nyin re bzhin thun drug gam/ bzhi'am/ gnyis su dkyil 'khor bdag mdun bum sogs mtha' dag la dmigs te/ dpon slob rnams chabs cig pas skyabs sems nas bzung dzb gyi bar thog mar las byang tshar gcig btang*/ de nas brtsam ste nyin mtshan kun tu sngags rgyun ma chad par bya ste// rdo rje slob dpon 'dzb kyi dus// rdo rje rgyal 'theb pas 'phrin las// bstod pa'i bar yang rdzogs par bya// slob dpon gyis ni sgrub rdzas kyi// gzungs thag der gtad bshags dang tshogs// rgyal 'theb pas ni 'dzb nyid de/ rgyal theb kyis las byang 'don pa'i dus su rdo rje slob dpon gyis dzb kho na bzla/ /de bzhin rin chen pad+ma dang*// las kyi rgyal 'theb rim pas bskor/ nyin re bzhin dkyil 'khor gyi lho nas tshogs mchod 'bulazhing bshags pa bya/ nub tu gu gul dang sha chen gyi gsur dud sbyar zhing*/ zhun chen gyi mar me dang bcas pas bskang ba dam rdzas bam bskang 'don/

nub re bzhin dkyil 'khor gyi byang du bkod pa'i thun gtor bzlog bsgyur gyi tshig 'don pa dang bcas 'phangs/ byang shar mtshams su nya'u bsgral ba rnams ma chag par bya'o// de lta bu'i sgo nas sgrub pa'i yun tshad// zla ba gcig gam lo dag gam// gang 'dod rtags dang bstun nas bsgrub// yang sgrub chen gyi 'dra 'bag mos slob tsam la ni/ zhag lnga'am bdun sogs ji tsam 'dod par bya ba yang ngo*/ bdag 'jug kyang nyin re bzhin grub na legs/ min kyang dbang bskur ba'i gong du nges par dgos so// gsum pa 'jug bstan dbab dang sprod// 'jug pa phyi nang phyi la yang*// khrus bskrad gsol drang phyag bya gsol// spro bskyed nyan gdams sems gnyis sdom// sta gon ji bzhin 'dir yang ngo*/ zhes pas khrus nas bzung*/ bho dhi tsit+ta a drā u pa da ya mi/ zhes pa'i bar sta gon skabs ltar bya// nang 'jug gdong g.yogs maṇ+ḍal phul// gsol drang dri dang khas blang ngo*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐// mig dar bcings la maṇ+ḍal phul/ bla ma dang 'jam dpal zil gnon dbyer ma mchis pa'i drung du/ dkyil 'khor chen por 'jug cing dbang bzhi rdzogs par zhu ba'i yon du zhes so// mos gus chen pos gsol 'debs gsum/ /hūm̐ yang gsang gshed po'i dkyil 'khor du// bdag ni 'jug par 'tshal lags kyi// rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gtso// dpa' bos bdag la bka' drin stsol/ lan gsum/ /slob dpon gyis ni rdo rje gtad// rim bzhin nang du drangs pa'i dus/ /hūm̐ 'khor ba'i sems can ma lus kun// rgyud lnga lam gyi sgo bcad de// mtho ris thar pa'i sgo phye nas// bla med gnas su drang bar bya// oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ de nas rdo rje mgor bzhag nas/ /skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod kyis// gsang ba'i dam tshig bsrung nus sam// sgrub mchog brtul zhugs spyod nus sam// mngon spyod las rnams byed nus sam//

lan gsum bar dri slob mas kyang*/ /rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol// khyod kyi bka' stsal bdag rjes bsgrub// dam tshig sdom pa gang yin dang*// gsang ba'i las kun sgrub par 'tshal// brtul zhugs chen po bla med pa// mthar lam phyin pa spyod par 'tshal// 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i bya ba rnams// ji ltar gsungs pa nyan par 'tshal// zhes pas khas blangs bya ba yin// dgongs gsol sgo phye phyag lha bstan// slob ma'i rgyud ni byin brlab pa// slob dpon gyis ni dkyil 'khor lhar/ /lha dang rdo rje slob dpon mched// phyogs mtshams kun nas mkhyen pa'i dpal// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ lan gsum// zhes brjod sgo phye 'di yis so/ /ho ye shes rnam pa kun ldan zhing*// dur khrod chen po'i gzhal yas khang*// yul las 'das pa'i ye shes kyis// mkha' dbyings dag pa'i shar sgo phye// sgo dbye ba'i phyag rgya bya// zhes pas dkyil 'khor chen po yi// phyogs shar sgo ni shag gis bye// slob ma dkyil 'khor shar sgor zhugs/ /mnyam nyid dag pa'i tshul gyis phyag 'tshal lo// lan gsum gyis phyag bya/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa yab yum rtsa ba'i lha bzhi/ gyad gnon gyi lha brgyad/ sprul pa las gshin yab yum drug /lo gshed pho mo nyer bzhi/ zla gshed bcu gnyis/ sbas pa'i ma bzhi/ zhag gshed so gnyis/ sgo ba gshed chen bzhi/ yum ro langs ma bzhi/ za ma'i gshin rje bka' nyan ji snyed pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa zhal mngon sum du khra hram mer bzhugs pa rnams la mos gus dungs pa byas pas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i dbang phyug 'jam dpal zil gnon chen po'i/ gyis shig /zhes bstan byin brlab 'di yin no/ /mdzod spu'i dbus nas 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa na ra ra byung khyed rang rnams kyi bdag 'jug skabs rang gi zhes bsgyur dgos pa 'og ma kun la shes/

smin mtshams su zhugs lus la thim pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i lus kyi sgrib pa thams cad bya sgro mes tshig pa ltar bsregs/ mgul gyi dbus nas 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa na ra ra byung khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa nas zhugs ngag la thim/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /thugs ka'i dbus nas 'od zer sngon po dpag tu med pa na ra ra byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga nas zhugs yid la thim/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag par mos/ de nas lho sgor phyin nas su/ sngar bzhin sgo phye phyag byas lha/ byin brlab spro bsdu nub byang la'ang*/ ho ye shes rnam pa sogs/ mkha' dbyings dag pa'i lho sgo dbye/ zhes dang*/ mnyam nyid dag pa'i sogs lan gsum/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal phyag rgya chen po sogs lha ngo bstan pa byin rlabs bsdu ba/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag par gyur/ bar snga ma ltar te phyogs lhag ma gnyis la'ang bsgres shes par bya'o/

/dbab la dam gnyis maṇ+ḍal gsol/ bskyed dgug bstim sngags me tog dor// brtag dang lha bstim dag tu bshad// mna' chu byin nas 'di skad brjod/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha dza hūm̐ ṭha ṭhaḥ.i dan+na ra skan/ rak+sha sogs kyi 'phreng bskon la/ /rigs kyi bu mchog rdo rje khyod// de ring phan chad nga yi bu// nga yis bsgo bar bya ba dang*// dam tshig la yang gnas par gyis// ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du// maṇ+ḍal phul nas gus pas su/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa yis// chos dbyings ye shes pho brang nas// ye shes khro bo'i sprin chen po// ma lus bdag la dbab tu gsol// bum pa'i mgul gyi ā+oṃ byang rnams// slob ma'i mgor bzhag 'di skad brjod/ /dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo 'jam dpal phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i thugs ka nas yi ge ā+oṃ re khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor byon pa'i mos pa gyis/ hūm̐ thig le'i ngo bo 'jam dpal sku// chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid// na ro rdo rje sems dpa'i sku// me long ye shes ngo bo nyid// zla tshes pad+ma dbang gi sku// kun rtog ye shes ngo bo nyid// 'a ni don yod grub pa'i sku// bya ba nan tan ngo bo nyid// a ni sangs rgyas bde gshegs sku// mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid// yig 'bru lnga yis byin brlabs pas// sku lnga ye shes ldan par shog /ā+oṃ de 'od du zhu nas khyed rnams kyi lus la zhugs pas lus mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rgyu dang rkyen med par/ khyed rang rnams phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i cesasogs e ring ji bzhin brjod/ /thugs kar sa bon yi ge hūm̐ mthinganag /de las dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pa'i sgra dang bcas pa'i 'od zer bla ma'i thugs kar phog

/bla ma'i thugs ka nas lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu thogs pa'i pho nya dpag tu med pa spros te/ chos kyi dbyings drag po e'i gzhal yas khang nas bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa yab yum rtsa ba'i lha bzhi/ gyad gnon gyi lha brgyad/ sprul pa las gshin yab yum drug /lo gshed pho mo nyer bzhi/ zla gshed bcu gnyis/ sbas pa'i ma bzhi/ zhag gshed so gnyis/ sgo ba gshed chen bzhi/ yum ro langs ma bzhi/ za ma'i gshin rje bka' nyan ji snyed pa'i 'khor dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i snying kar lcags kyus dzaḥ zhags pas hūm̐/ lcags sgrog gis baṃ/ dril bus hoḥmadun gyi nam mkhar char bab pa bzhin du byon pa khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa gyis/ sku gsung thugs kyi sngags kyi mthar/ dzñā na ā be sha ya āḥ zhes pa btags la drag tu bzla// spos kyis bdug cing rol mo bsgrag /gar dang brda skad 'phar sogs 'byung*/ brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyis spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag /de nas dkyil 'khor drung khrid la/ maṇ+ḍal la pad+ma 'dab brgyad steng tshom bu lnga'am dgu bkod pa dkyil 'khor lhar mos la/ /hūm̐ bde chen rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor du// rig pa'i me tog 'di dor bas// sngon tshe las 'phro yod pa'i lha// gang yin mchog la 'bab par shog /e ka ya ma mu dra traṃ puṣ+pe sa ma ya pū tsa hoḥ gtso bor dmigs nas me tog dor// gtso bo mchog la 'khor thun mong*/ e thung brjod cing me tog slar spyi bor 'ching*// me tog blangs te spyi bor bzhag /phog pa'i lha de'i sngags brjod nas// de nyid lus la thim par bsgom// mig dbye gsol dbye lha ngo sprad/ /shin tu ma rig mun pa yis// bdag nyid long bar gyur pa las// 'jam dpal thugs rje chen po yis// bdag gi mig 'di dbye ru gsol// oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya phaṭ//

gsol btab mig thur thogs nas su/ /ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar// bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i// rab rib 'jam dpal bdag gis bsal// tsak+ṣu pra be shag / ces gdong g.yogs bsal// de nas lha ngo sprad pa ni/ de ring phan chad bu khyod kyis// rtsol ba'i sems stobs las byung bar// dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// gzhan la gsang ba ma smra zhig /bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dkyil 'khor chen po rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum du mjal bar gyur pa nyid/ ngo bo chos nyid spros pa dang bral bas na ka dag /rang bzhin nam rnam pa ni rang byung gi ye shes las phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i dkyil 'khor rten brten pa dang bcas par rang shar bas lhun grub/ de yang*/ don bla na med pa'i sa la lhun gyis rdzogs pa dang*/ rtags kyi gdug pa can bsgral bar bstan pa de/ yang dag par na don rtags gnyis su med pa'o// dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa nyid sbyor ba sna tshogs su ma 'gags par spyod pa ni thugs rje ste/ hril gyis bsgril na/ ya gi 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po nas ma gi dkyil 'khor chen po'i dur khrod la gnas pa'i 'byung po'i bar rten dang brten par bcas pa gzhi ma bcos pa de kho na nyid chos sku 'gyur ba med par gcig /sku mtshan ma'i gzugs su snang ba kun ni sgyu ma lhun grub ye shes longs spyod rdzogs par gcig /las sna tshogs so so nas 'dul ba ni sprul pa'i sku ru gcig ste/ de ltar sku gsum gyi rol pa rang rang gi don la spyod pa ni// chos nyid la chos nyid rol/ ye shes la ye shes rol// sprul pa la sprul pa rol pa ste/ rgyud las kyang*/ ngo bo ma bcos chos kyi sku// chos sku 'gyur ba med par gcig /sku dang mtshan mar btags pa kun// ye shes lhun gyis grub pa'i sku// las dang sbyor ba sna tshogs kun// sgyu ma lhun grub sprul pas 'dul// rol pa'i phyag rgyar snang ba'o//

zhes pas lha ngo sprad pa'am// rgyas 'dod phyag rgya gsal sgron bzhin// bum dbang phyi la gsang dbang nang*// sher dbang gsang dang bam chen dbang*// bla med dbang la'o bum pa la// bum cod rdor dril ming lha drug /bla ma sku rdo rje bdag nyid can gyi drung du lus kyi sgrib pa sbyangs shing sku rdo rje'i byin rlabs kyi nus pa 'jog pa bum pa'i dbang skur zhu ba'i yon du// phyag byas maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol/ /hūm̐ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa dang*/ srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa dang*/ stong gsum yum du bsgrub pa'i phyir// dus gsum sangs rgyas dbang bskur stsol// 'jam dpal gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du// bsnyen sgrub las la sbyar ba dang*// dkyil 'khor las mtha' brten pa'i phyir// phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang bskur stsol// gshed bzhi sbyor ba 'khor lo dang*// ban dgra gsod dang bsgral ba dang*// 'phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub pa'i phyir// mthu rtsal dbang bskur stsal du gsol// lan gsum/ las bum gyi chus khrus bya zhing*/ /hūm̐ rin chen dngul gyi bum pa ni// byang chub sems kyi chu yis bkang*// byang chub chu yis khrus byas pas// nyon mongs bag chags byang gyur cig /oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ khrus byas sdig sgrib dag par bsam// khyed rang rnams rang nyid zil gnon rat+na he ru ka ser nag g.yas thod dbyug g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ yum khros ma mā ma ki tri shū la dang thod khrag 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba dpal chen po'i chas brgyad kyis brjid pa/ g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥsnying gar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i thugs ka nas dbang gi lha rigs lnga yab yum/ sems dpa' sems ma/ khro bo khro mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/

gshegs ma rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi lnga'i chus gang bas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul// khro bo dang khro mo'i rgyal mo rnams kyis bgegs skrod pa 'i mos pa gyis/ rnam rgyal bum pa thogs la/ hūm̐ ngo bo mnyam nyid ye shes las// rang bzhin yon tan lha ru gsal// rnam pa bum chu'i dbang bskur bas// rin chen rigs kyi dbang thob shog /oṃ e ka ya ma rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ rigs kyi bu khyed rnams la bum pa chu dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas nga rgyal rnam par dag nas rin po che'i rigs thams cad kyi dbang dang ldan te mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes thob par gyur cig / ༈ khyed rang rnams zil gnon pad+ma he ru ka dmar nag g.yas pad+ma g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ yum khros ma na bza' dkar mo/ tri shū la sogs gong ltar/ gshegs ma rnams kyis rin po che'i cod pan dar dpyangs kyi phur ma dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sogs/ cod pan thogs la/ hūm̐ ngo bo sor rtog ye shes las// rang bzhin gsung gi lha ru gsal// rnam pa cod pan dbang bskur bas/ pad+ma rigs kyi dbang thob shog /oṃ e ka ya ma pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ rigs kyi bu khyod rnams la cod pan dar dpyangs dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas 'dod chags rnam par dag nas pad+ma'i rigs thams cad kyi dbang dang ldan te so sor rtog pa'i ye shes thob par gyur cig ༈ khyed rang rnams zil gnon karma he ru ka ljang nag g.yas ral gri g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ yum khros ma dam tshig sgrol ma/ tri shū la dang sogs/ gshegs ma rnams kyis dril bu sgra dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ dril bu thogs la/ hūm̐ ngo bo bya grub ye shes las// rang bzhin 'phrin las lha ru gsal// rnam pa dril bu'i dbang bskur bas// las kyi rigs kyi dbang thob shog

/oṃ e ka ya ma karma a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ rigs kyi bu khyod rnams la dril bu sgra dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas phrag dog rnam par dag nas las kyi rigs kyi dbang dang ldan te bya ba grub pa'i ye shes thob par gyur cig /༈ khyed rang rnams zil gnon badz+ra he ru ka mthing nag g.yas rdo rje g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ yum rdo rje khros ma nam mkha' dbyings phyug ma/ tri shū la dang sogs/ /gshegs ma rnams kyis rdo rje gsor ba dang bcas pas dbang bskur= / rdo rje thogs la/ hūm̐ ngo bo me long ye shes las// rang bzhin thugs kyi lha ru gsal// rnam pa rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas// rdo rje'i rigs kyi dbang thob shog /oṃ e ka ya ma badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ rigs kyi bu khyed rnams la rdo rje gsor ba dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas zhe sdang rnam par dag nas rdo rje'i rigs thams cad kyi dbang dang ldan te me long lta bu'i ye shes thob par gyur cig ༈ khyed rang rnams zil gnon bud+dha he ru ka smug nag g.yas 'khor lo g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/ yum khros ma sangs rgyas spyan ma/ tri shū la sogs/ gshegs ma rnams kyis ming 'di zhes bya bar 'bod pa dang bcas pas dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' sogs/ rdo rje dang bcas dril bu spyi bor dkrol zhing*/ hūm̐ ngo bo chos dbyings ye shes las// rang bzhin sku yi lha ru gsal// rnam pa ming gi dbang bskur bas// chos dbyings ye shes thob par shog /oṃ e ka ya ma bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ rigs kyi bu khyod rnams la ming 'bod pa dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas gti mug rnam par dag nas bde bar gshegs pa'i rigs thams cad kyi dbang dang ldan te chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes thob par gyur cig / rdo rje slob dpon dgongs par bzhugs// bum sogs rdo rje rgyal 'theb pas// brim par bya zhes mkhas pas bshad// skyes pa bud med rim pas ni// ming yang khrag 'thung yab yum ste// me tog gang bab de gdags so// rigs kyi bu khyod rnams la

de ltar phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i sgo nas he ru ka lnga'i dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa lnga gnas su dag /rig pa ye shes lnga'i dbang thob pas/ phung po lnga khrag 'thung rigs lngar gnas 'gyur ba'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no// ye shes lha dbang dag la ni// sku gsung thugs su shes par bya// gtso bo lus dkyil bzhin du bsgom/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta= āḥdharma hri tu swa bhā wa bi shud+dho3 haṃ/ hūm̐ badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐/ ka nas dag pa de bzhin nyid kyi sogs a+ye ring bsnyen pa'i skabs ltar 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrugs pa'i klong na bzhugs par gyur zhes pa'i bar dang*/ gzhan rnams 'di bzhin brjod pas te/ /'byung ba'i dwangs ma bzhi gtso bo'i lha bzhi/ 'byung ba'i snyigs ma bzhi gyad gnon gyi lha bzhi/ dug gsum las gshin gsum/ nyon mongs pa bzhi gsang ba'i gshed bzhi/ rnam shes brgyad mon pa bzhi dang bdud bzhi/ sems byung gi rgyu ba zhag dang za gshed/ gnas skabs bzhi'i thig le sgo ba bzhi la sogs pa lus gdod ma nas phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por grub pa'i phyir/ ye nas yin pa la yin par shes par gyis shig /pho brang nang na dkyil 'khor lha tshogs khra lam mer bzhugs pa rnams las rang 'dra ba re chad de khyed rang rnams la gnyis su med par thim pas dregs pa sku'i dbang thob pa'i mos pa gyis shig /gtso bo'i tsaka li mgo thog bzhag /'phrin las bstod pa'i phyag 'tshal tshab/ dbang bskur ro zhes sbyar bas bskur/ hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings nas go 'byed gzugs phung dgrar// phyag rgya zil gnon mun pa chen po'i sku// rngams pa'i dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad// bde gshegs khro bo'i tshogs rje'i dbang bskur ro// e ka kro te ka ya mān+ta ka kā la rū pa hriṣ+ṭi a pa ye hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ zhes pas so// yum dang rtsa dang gyad las gshin// gshed dang mon bdud zhag dang sgo// lhag ma thams cad gcig tu bya/

stong nyid ye shes dngos 'dzin ma mo'i dgrar// sbyor yum sgrol yum dbyings yum gtum pa'i gzugs// dur khrod chas brgyan khams gsum dbang du sdud// gsang ba'i yum chen rnams kyi dbang bskur ro// oṃ āḥhūm̐ dza e pai tā lī kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐/ e ma ma e ka dzā ṭi hūm̐/ e de ma kha la baṃ ril ru lu ru lu bh+yo hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ ye shes bzhi ni 'byung bzhi phung bzhi'i dgrar// sras mchog ya ma rā dza phyag rdor dang*// rus sbal rngams pa mi zan gdug pa'i khyung*// rigs bzhi'i khro rgyal rnams kyi dbang bskur ro// e badz+ra kro dha ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐/ e ya ma rā dza kro dha hūm̐/ e ma hā bhi ru ka ye hūm̐/ e khroṃ ga ru ṇa hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ sprul pa bzhi ni sde brgyad dregs pa'i dgrar// seṅge stag chen sbrul nag khyung smug po// rang 'dra'i yum bcas drag shul chen po'i gzugs// gyad gnon yab yum rnams kyi dbang bskur ro// e ka he dun ya ma rā dza hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ sku gsung thugs ni nyon mongs dug gi dgrar// 'chi bdag srog bdag tshe bdag bdud kyi bdud// yum bcas mi sdug dgur brdzu mtshon chas gsod// las gshin rgyal po gsum gyi dbang bskur ro// oṃ ya ma du sha hūm̐/ oṃ ya ma rak+sha hūm̐/ oṃ ya ma yak+sha hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ ye shes rang mdangs srid gsum srog gi dgrar// ya ma rā dza myos byed 'bar ba dang*// ār+ya ma ru ral pa tshar dgu ste// srin mo yum dang bcas pa'i dbang bskur ro// ya ma rā dza sa do me yaḥ ya me do ru ṇa yo da yaḥ ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe yaḥ yak+ṣe ye tsa ni ra ma yaḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ yang sprul rnam par shes pa brgyad kyi dgrar// rngams pa'i mon pa pho mo bzhi bzhi dang*// rab 'jigs bdud bzhi bdud mo nag mo bzhi// lo gshed pho mo rnams kyi dbang bskur ro/ tsaṇ+ḍa ru tra man+to dzaḥ

ya ma man+to dzaḥ rak+sha man+to dzaḥ yak+sha man+to dzaḥ ru tri ru lu ha hā ya/ du ru ya ma snying du ya/ du tra bha ti ru sha ya/ ru tra yak+sha trig+na ya/ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ nying sprul gling bzhi 'gro ba yongs kyi dgrar// ma rungs las byed 'chi bdag bcu gnyis po// phung byed sbas pa'i ma mo bzhis 'khyud pa// zla ba'i gshed chen rnams kyi dbang bskur ro// e ya ma rā dzaḥ kro ne kro ne/ pa kra pa kra/ shū la shū la/ dha sha gri ba/ yak+sha gri ba/ ru lu ru lu/ ha ha/ ya ya/ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ sprul pa'i pho nya nyams pa rnams kyi dgrar// bdud dang gshin rje ma mo gnod sbyin tshogs// gtum po gzhan gyis mi thub gyad 'dra ba// za ma'i gshed chen so gnyis dbang bskur ro// ru tra ha la nag po/ ya ma du na rak+sha ya/ ru ru tsa pa la/ kha la rak+mo thun bh+yo/ yak+sha ti nan baṃ bh+yo a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ// chos skyong che rnams bdud dang mu stegs dgrar// dkar po snying 'byin nag po chen po dang*// yab rje nag po gnod sbyin dmar por sprul// sgo ba yab yum brgyad kyi dbang bskur ro// tri tsa pa la a shu me ya/ ma hā kā la ya/ ru dra du ru ya/ rak+sha ru lu ha ha ya/ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ/ gzhan yang bshan pa gtum po 'jig rten dgrar// gshed chen drug cu ma ra khrag skyugs te// dregs pa sum cu bstan ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// dpal gyi 'khor tshogs rnams kyi dbang bskur ro// ya ma ya ma/ du na du na/ shaṃ shuṃ/ ghṛ ṇa ghṛ ṇa/ pa tsa pa tsa/ be ra be ra/ ha la ha la/ hū la ya hū la ya/ ma ma ru ru/ na ga he de tri ta/ nṛ la dun bh+yo/ dun bh+yo ya/ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ//

rgyas 'dod re res bskur ba yin// dpral bar rdo rje'i dri thig bya/ oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ spyi bor zla ba'i steng du oṃ dkar pos rgyas btab pa 'i mos pa gyis/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis de ltar dregs pa sku'i dbang thob pa yin pas/ deng phyin chad brtan pa snod kyi 'jig rten thams cad dur khrod kyi dkyil 'khor/ g.yo ba bcud kyi sems can thams cad khrag 'thung chen po'i lha tshogs su shes par gyis shig / gsung gi dbang ni 'di lta bu/ sngon chad bsod nams bsags pa yis// bla med theg mchog 'di dang mjal// bde chen ngang nas sku bzhengs la// phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor gsal ba yi// sangs rgyas kun gyi snying po mchog /'bru brgyad sngags kyi bro chen brdung*// zhes bskul thams cad brgyan pas bzhengs// dkyil 'khor mtha' la bskor bzhin du// brjid pa dpa' bo'i bro chen dang*// dgyes pa dpa' mo'i glu dbyangs bstun/ e myags ya brngubs mug shaka ka dun/ zhes dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' bskor te dzb bro bya/ hūm̐ dang po'i sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir// skye dang 'chi ba bya ba med// 'khor ba ye nas sangs rgyas te/ ngan song gsum po lta bas bsgral// rnam rtog gdod nas chos sku yin// snang srid ma bcos phyag rgya'i zhing*// thams cad dregs pa'i lha tshogs la// 'bru brgyad sngags kyi mchod pa 'bul// thams cad grags stong ye shes te// gsung gi dngos grub chen po stsol// 'di ni ye shes chen po'i bro// 'khor 'das gnyis su med par brdung*// phyag rgya zil gnon mchog gi lam// lam 'di kun gyis thob gyur cig / ces brjod dus su dkyil 'khor lha'i// thugs nas drag sngags char pa bab// bdag gi ngag thim bsams nas 'dug /khyed rang rnams kyi snying gyen du kha phyogs pa'i snying tshil zla gdan/ snying rin po che zur brgyad pa'i nang du hūm̐ mthing nag

/bla ma'i thugs kha'i sa bon las thugs kyi sngags kyi 'phreng ba 'od zer mgal me 'khor ba lta bu 'thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi kha nas song snying kha'i hūm̐ yig gi mthar g.yas skor du hraṃ me 'dug pas rdo tshan la snum mi chags pa bzhin du yid kyi sgrib pa sbyangs pa'i mos pa gyis/ e myags ya rngubs mug shaka ka dun hūm̐ phaṭ/ thugs kyi sngags ni lan gsum byin/ ljags kyi rtse mo las gsung gi sngags me'i tshwa tshwa lta bu 'phros pa khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa nas zhugs ngag gi sgrib pa dang sdig pa thams cad sbyangs par mos la sa bon hūm̐ gi tshab tu āḥbakod nas/ e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces/ gsung gi sngags ni lan gsum byin/ sku'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas sku'i sngags 'ja' tshon lta bu 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyi bu ga thams cad nas zhugs/ lus kyi sgrib pa dang sdig pa thams cad sbyangs par mos la sa bon oṃ bkod nas/ oṃ e ka ya ma he dun rak+sha dun dun dza ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ sku yi sngags ni lan gsum byin/ /dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad dang slob dpon gyi gnas thams cad nas sngags 'phreng la la dkar po zhi bar byed pa'i nus pa can mgal me 'khor ba lta bu/ la la ser po sgro yi chun po lta bu rgyas par byed pa'i nus pa can/ la la dmar po lcags sgrog 'khyil ba lta bu dbang du byed pa'i nus pa can/ la la nag po me'i tshwa tshwa lta bu drag po dgra bgegs sgrol bar byed pa'i nus pa can sprin las char ltar du thon pa khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum dang ro gcig tu gyur pas/ drag sngags kyi dbang thob pa'i mos pa gyis/ a+yā+e ring e thung lan gsum gsum/ de nas rdo rjes mgrin par thig /na mas+sarba ta thā ga ta wā ka badz+ra sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa la āḥdamar pos rgyas btab par

mos/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis de ltar drag po sngags kyi dbang thob pa yin pas ngag gi brjod pa thams cad sngags kyi sgrar shes par gyis shig /slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kar zug /thugs kyi byin brlabs thams cad phyag rgya dang mtshan ma'i rnam par char bzhin du bab pa khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pa 'i mos pa gyis/ slob ma'i lag g.yas phyag mtshan gtad/ hūm̐ 'khor ba sgrol byed 'khor lo dang*// nyon mongs gcod byed ral gri dang*// chos nyid mtshon pa'i rdo rje yi// sku gsung thugs kyi dbang thob shog /e ka ya ma tsakra khat+ga badz+ra ya hoḥ g.yon par gtad cing 'di skad du/ hūm̐ be con dug lnga ye shes sgrol// gtun shing dgra bgegs 'dul bar byed// sdigs mdzub bag chags bsdigs pa ste// rig pa'i dbang mchog thob par shog /e ka ya ma bhi sa hūm̐ ti ra hoḥ snying gar rdo rjes dri thig bya/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra sid+dhi a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ snying khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig sngon pos rgyas btab par mos/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis de ltar dregs pa thugs kyi dbang thob pa yin pas yid rgyu ba thams cad chos nyid la chos nyid rol ba yin par shes par gyis shig / dkyil 'khor rngul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du khyed rang rnams kyi yul snang lus la/ bum pa'i cho ga drug gi dbang bskur bas bum pa'i dbang thob/ byed pa lus kyi sgrib pa dag /lam khyer bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku thob// sku'i 'phrin las kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin no// gnyis pa gsang dbang la// byang sems rak+ta gtor ma chas// tshe tshogs drug gi gsang ba'i dbang*// slob ma'i gdong g.yog maṇ+ḍal phul/ bla ma gsung rdo rje'i bdag nyid can gyi drung du/

ngag gi dri ma sbyangs shing gsung rdo rje'i byin rlabs kyi nus pa 'jog pa/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar bcings la/ /'gyur med bde chen pho brang nas// dregs pa'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol// dam tshig dka' thub sdom pa'i mchog /gsang ba'i sgrol ma bdag la stsol/ lan gsum/ bla ma yab yum bcom ldan 'das phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i tshe bdag yab yum du gsal ba'i gsang ba dang mkha' hūm̐ dang hrīḥlas skyes pa'i rdo rje dang pad+ma/ nor bu dang ze'u 'brur/ oṃ dang āḥs byin gyis brlabs pa 'dus byas snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bskul/ sku'i cha thams cad nas zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba 'khor lo bzhi'i lte bar babs/ dga' bzhi'i ye shes mngon du mdzad/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mo nas yum gyi rtsakā ka mu kha'i sgor dkar dmar ro gcig tu 'dres pa/ ༈ rig pa'i stobs ldan sbyor ba'i mthus// 'khrul pa'i bag chags sprin gtor nas// ye shes nam mkha' gsal byed pa// gnyis med brtul zhugs chen po longs// e ka ya ma pra tīts+tsha hoḥ yab kyi byang sems dkar char mos pa'i thod chang sbyin/ bla mas de brjod slar gzungs mas/ 'di ste khrag 'thung yab yum gyi// dam tshig rmad byung chen po ste// khams lnga ldan pas ro rtogs byed// bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis// skye gnas byang sems gnang ba de/ /a ho ma hā su khaṃ/ yum gyi dmar char mos pa'i thod chang tshar gcig sbyin/ de nas rang gi lce yis myang*/ mig dar bsal/ rtog can sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo gtso bor gyur pa'i rtsa thams cad khyab/ skye gnas mthong bas lhag par bskul ba'i bde ba sgyu ma'i snang ba sna tshogs su gsal ba so so rang rig pa'i ngo bo nyid mngon du byed par gyur/ rak+ta gtor ma mchod pa'i tshig

/dbang bskur 'don pa bsgyur la bskur/ hūm̐ dwangs ma snying khrag bsgral ba shwa na'i khrag /mū la rten 'brel mkha' dbyings pad+ma'i khrag /dung chen snod du rgya mtshor 'khyil ba'i rba// 'jigs pa'i lbu phreng chags pas dbang bskur ro// e ka ya ma gu h+ya rak+ta bo dhi tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa ho/ zhes rak+ta lag par gtad/ hūm̐ phyi snod 'jig rten khams kyi snod chen por// nang bcud srid pa gsum la sbrus pa'i rdzas// 'byung lnga lhun grub dkar dmar snang bas brgyan// dpal gyi gtor ma chen pos dbang bskur ro// e ka ya ma ba ling dzñā na pū dza a bhi ṣiñtsa ho/ zhes pas dbang gtor mgor 'jog /thod 'phreng mgo la bskon nas su/ /hūm̐ thod pa tshar gsum 'phreng ba 'di// dug gsum sku gsum du bsgral nas// 'das dang ma 'ongs da ltar gyi// rgyal ba kun gyi dbang thob shog / mgo rlon ga shal byin nas su/ /hūm̐ khrag 'dzag mgo bo'i ga shal 'dis// sems byung ye shes su bsgral bas// khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba dang*// srid gsum zil gyis non gyur cig / thal chen tshom bu dpral bar btab/ /hūm̐ thal chen tshom bu 'di btab pas// thugs rje mtha' ru phyin pa'i dbang*// skye 'gro ma lus dbugs phyung nas// smin grol byed pa'i dbang thob shog / mkhur 'dzum sna rtser khrag chen bsku/ /hūm̐ rak+ta'i thig le 'di btab pas// thugs rje chags pa'i dbang nyid de// rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' bar// 'gro don byed pa'i dbang thob shog / snying khar rtse gsum zhag gis bri/ /hūm̐ zhag chen sor ris 'di btab pas// dam rdzas bcud kyi dbang mchog ste// sangs rgyas kun gyi byin rlabs kyis// skye shi med pa'i dbang thob shog / sbrul chun sked la bcing phyir sbyin/ /hūm̐ sbrul nag chun po'i ska rags 'di// zhe sdang rtsad nas gcod pa'i dbang*// na rag dmyal ba bsgral ba'i phyir// zhe sdang dag pa'i dbang thob shog

/ glang chen ko rlon stod g.yogs su/ /hūm̐ glang chen ko rlon chen po 'di// theg pa chen po thob pa'i dbang*// ma lus de la gnas bya'i phyir// theg chen chos kyi dbang thob shog / zhing lpags g.yang gzhi sked par dkri/ /hūm̐ zhing gi g.yang gzhi chen po 'di// gti mug rtsad nas gcod pa'i dbang*// tir ya ka ni bsgral bya'i phyir// gti mug dag pa'i dbang thob shog / stag gi sham thabs smad la dkris/ /hūm̐ stag lpags sham thabs chen po 'di// 'phrin las rnam bzhi rdzogs pa'i dbang*// zhi rgyas dbang drag las bya'i phyir// thabs kyi don byed dbang thob shog / rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan byas la/ /hūm̐ rus pa'i rgyan drug chen po 'di// 'dod chags rtsad nas gcod pa'i dbang*// pre ta ka ni bsgral ba'i phyir// 'dod chags dag pa'i dbang thob shog / tshe yi dbang ni 'di yin no// khyed rang rnams kyi snying gru gsum pa'i nang du/ nyi ma 'og dang steng du zla ba kha sbyar ba'i gwa'u'i nang du tshe'i gzungs nṛ/ de'i gi gu na ra ta gsum las 'od dkar dmar mthing kha spros/ srid pa gsum gyi tshe srog thams cad bsdus de la thim/ 'od kyi thig le gcig tu gyur pa'i mos pa gyis/ hūm̐ bkra shis brtan pa'i gwa'u ru// mi 'gyur brtan pa'i tshe bskyil nas// rang rtags tshe yi dbang bskur bas// 'chi med tshe yi dbang thob shog /a+ye a+ye a+ye ya ma nṛ bh+rūṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ dza ཿ zhes pas tshe gal spyi bor bzhag /tshe yi lha mo bdud rtsir zhu nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor zhugs/ 'chi med kyi bdud rtsis lus dkar mer gyis gang ba 'i mos pa gyis/ /de nas tshogs kyi dbang bya ste/ hūm̐ 'chi med bdud rtsi rā sa na/ bkra shis mtshan ldan lhag pa'i rdzas// 'phel 'grib med pa'i dbang bskur bas// rigs lnga ye shes dbang thob shog / ces tshogs rdzas lag tu gtad/ 'chi ba med pa zhal zas kyi dbang bskur bas mi zad pa'i gter la longs spyod pa'i dbang dam pa thob par gyur cig
