/de ltar dkyil 'khor slob dpon gyi lus/ khyed rang rnams kyi slob ma'i ngag la/ byang chub sems la sogs pa drug gi dbang bskur bas gsang ba'i dbang thob/ byed pa ngag gi sgrib pa dag /lam khyer rtsa rlung thig le bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob ste/ gsung gi 'phrin las kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin no// sher dbang gsol spro gnyis lan thig /dri lan gtad dbab slob sbyang bskyed// snyoms 'jug don bstan nges don bshad/ bla ma thugs rdo rje'i bdag nyid can gyi drung du/ yid kyi dri ma sbyang zhing thugs rdo rje'i byin rlabs kyi nus pa 'jog pa shesarab ye shes kyi dbang bskur zab mo zhu ba'i yon du/ maṇ+ḍal phul zhing gsol gdab pa/ bha ga gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor nas// mnyam pa'i rgyal po dgongs su gsol// dam tshig tshangs spyod sdom pa'i mchog /ye shes rol pa bdag la stsol/ lan gsum/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig dar 'ching*// gdong g.yogs nas ni gzungs ma la/ /bha ga gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi// ye shes lhun gyis grub pa'i lhas// rig pa'i brtul zhugs sbyin byed la// gzungs ma yid 'ong spro bar gyis// de nas slob mar 'di skad brjod/ /'di 'dra'i dkyil 'khor bla na med// yang dag gsang ba'i lam mchog ste// bu khyod skal pa rab tu 'gyur// 'di dang mjal la dga' ba skyed/ slob mas lan du/ bdag cag shin tu spro ba lags// dpa' bo chen po bka' drin che// zhes zhus las mkhan der 'ongs nas// slob ma'i gnas lngar thig le bkod/ e ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// bha ga'i gnas la longs spyod dang*// gzungs ma mtshan ldan rtag tu brten// 'dod yon lnga la bde bar rol// gtsang dme ngo tsha'i rtog pa spongs// de ltar nus na brtul zhugs sbyin// bla ma'i tshig der lan slob mas/ dpa' bo chen pos bka' stsal ltar// bdag ni de ltar rjes su 'jug

/ slob ma'i lag g.yon gzungs mar gtad// gcer bu bha ga rgyas pa bstan/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas byon pa'i gnas// bde ba kun gyi 'byung gnas che// gnyis med cho gas snyoms zhugs nas// sangs rgyas thams cad mnyes par byos// khyed rang rnams 'od dpag med mdun gyi nam mkhar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas par gsal ba las/ nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi thams cad 'od kyis dmar lam lam gyur pa'i mos pa gyis// zhes brjod rol sgra spos kyis bdug /me long la has btab pa ltar/ 'od dpag med du gsal ba'i sku de je phra je phrar gyur te stong pa nyid du yal ba las 'jam dpal phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i sku/ gzungs ma rdo rje khros mar gsal ba rjes chags kyi sbyor bas bskul ba'i nang gi byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i rgyun gyis/ lus thams cad gang zhing*/ dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes mngon du byas pas/ yum gyi bha ga'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs rnams mchod de thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i bde ba chen po'i ngo bor mnyes nas byang chub kyi sems thig le zhu ba/ dung can gyi nang nas gyen du gshegs pa'i rim gyis/ phung po khams skye mched kyi snang ba thams cad sgyu ma lta bu'i ye shes kyi lha'i rol mor sad pa

'i mos pa gyis/ 'di ni gsang ba'i theg mchog ste// ye shes bla na med pa'i don// rang byung ye shes 'di las 'thob// 'di las mchog tu gzhan med do// gdong g.yogs bsal// sbyor du bcug nas de skad brjod/ de ltar dkyil 'khor shes rab ma'i bha ga / khyed rang rnams slob ma'i yid la snyoms par 'jug pa'i rdzas kyis dbang bskur bas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ byed pa yid kyi sgrib pa dag /lam khyer pho nya bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku thob ste thugs kyi 'phrin las kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin no// baṃ dbang la ni rjes gnang gsol// bskyed bskur rgyas btab bsgral bas blangs// ngo sprad gzengs bstod dbugs phyung la// rjes su gnang phyir slob dpon gyis/ /hi hi zhes pa'i bzhad sgra yis// steng 'og phyogs mtshams ci snang ba// thams cad dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs// ma lus kun gyi nang na yang*// bla med zil gnon rngam pa'i sku// gnyis med rol pa'i cha lugs kyi// bde chen lhag pa'i nga ro 'byung*// mnyam pa'i brtul zhugs sbyin par bya'o// bla ma ngo bo nyid sku'i bdag nyid can gyi drung du/ lus ngag yid gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma sbyangs shing*/ ye shes rdo rje'i byin rlabs kyi nus pa 'jog pa/ dbang bzhi pa tshig dbang rin po che zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul// slob ma rab dga' gus pa'i phyag /ci yang btsal nas 'di skad zhu/ /na mo che ba'i nang nas che ba'i mchog /phyag btsal phyag rgya zil gnon la'o// mnyam nyid brtul zhugs chen po yis// bam chen rtog med bde chen gang*// da lta nyid du ci nus phob/ lan gsum/ /e ma ho ngo mtshar rmad kyi chos// 'di 'dra'i theg chen bla na med// brtul zhugs da lta nyid du thob// ces rjes su gnang nas/ /hūm̐ muṃ rigs kyi bu khyed rang rnam bdag 'jug skabs rang nyid ces brjod pa kun la shes dgos/

'jam dpal phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lhar skad cig gis gsal ba'i dam tshig sems dpa' la/ baṃ chen gyi snying kha'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs kyi ye shes sems dpa' thams cad chil chil thim pas gnyis med bde ba chen po'i ngo bo gcig tu gyur pas ye shes bla na med pa'i dbang thob pa 'i mos pa gyis/ rol sgra spos ngad chil li lis/ a+ye ring dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ btags/ lan gsum bzlas la rdo rje'i rtses// dri yi thig les gnas gsum brgyan/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ sogs/ /kā wā tsi sngags sngar bzhin brjod// drag pos bsgral phyir ral gri gtad/ hūm̐ gshed chen mthu stobs yongs rdzogs las// dpag med 'phrin las mthar phyin zhing*// stong gsum srid pa zil mnan nas// snang srid skur sgrol dbang bskur ro// e ka he dun ya ma kro dha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ baṃ ro dum bur gtubs spungs khar// chang gi ka li gzhag nas su// bdud rtsi bzhin du byin gyis brlab/ thod dbus rigs lnga snyoms zhugs bdud rtsir zhu/ nyi bkab rta mgrin sbyor mtshams byang sems phab// bdag gi mtheb mdzub zla bas zag dang 'dres// mdangs dri ro bcud gter chen dpa' bos srung*/ oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥswā hā/ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐/ oṃ āḥsarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ// thams cad bdud rtsir skya mer zhu// de yis dbang bskur byin nas 'thung*/ /a ho/ 'di ni ngo mtshar rmad kyi thabs// 'chi med rang byung bdud rtsi'i gter// longs spyod dag pas dbang bskur bas// thams cad rdzogs pa'i dbang thob shog / baṃ chen māṃ sas dbang bskur sbyin/ /hūm̐ mnyam pa nyid kyi brtul zhugs kyis// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med par// ma 'gags ye shes rtsal shar bas// bam chen dme ba don dang sbyar// brtul zhugs sngags kyi byin rlabs bskyed// baṃ chen ro la mnyam par sbyar// rdo rje brjid pa'i dbang thob nas// bde chen mnyam nyid thob par shog

/e ka ya ma a dhi pa ti ti ra sid+dhi hoḥ gtsang dme'i rtog pa med par mnyam nyid chen po'i ngang du rol pas lus thams cad zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsis skya mer gyis gang bas bde chen lhun gyis grub pa'i mchog gi skal pa can du gyur pa'o// zhes brjod chang dang sha la rol/ rang sems ma bcos pa'i ngang la gzhag pas/ chos nyid skye ba med pa kun bzang bde chen yangs pa'i klong na 'khor 'das 'dam ka med pa/ mnyam nyid chen por khyab gdal ba chos kyi sku/ da lta rang gi rig pa 'di kho na dbang bzhi pa yin no// 'dir dkyil 'khor rang byung gi ye shes chos nyid khyab gdal chen po de yang baṃ gyi rnam par mtshon te/ baṃ la rtog pa skad cig kyang med bzhin/ skye mched thams cad bkra lam mer snang ba ni dkyil 'khor gyi rang bzhin/ don rnam par mi rtog pa'i chos nyid yin pas so// khyed rang rnams kyi de ltar kun gzhi'i rnam shes la rnam par mi rtog pa'i rdzas kyis dbang bskur bas/ dbang bzhi pa yang dag pa chos nyid mi rtog pa'i ye shes su thob/ byed pa shes sgrib dag /lam khyer phyag rgya chen po de kho na nyid bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid rdo rje'i sku thob ste/ 'phrin las thams cad kyis sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin no// rigs kyi bu khyed rnams de lta bu'i don dang ldan pas rgyud yongs su smin pa yin no// zhes pas gzengs bstod dbugs dbyung ba/ de ltar dbang bzhi thob nas dam tshig ma nyams par lam bsnyen sgrub rnam pa bzhi'i sgo nas bsgrubs na/ brtson 'grus can tshe gcig gis 'tshang rgya bas/ dman pa nyan rang ltar bskal pa grangs med du mar dka' ba spyad mi dgos te lam mchog chen po'i skal pas dge ba yin no// slob dpon mthu dang thun dang zor// de nas slob dpon byed pa'i phyir// gdugs phub seng khrir slob ma bkod// 'khor lo rkang 'og dung 'bud cing*// 'di rgyud po ti gtad nas su/

/phyag rgya chen po'i dkyil 'khor du// khyed kyis dbang rnams rdzogs par thob// da ni khyod kyis slob dpon gyis// slob ma smin cing grol bar mdzod// oṃ e ka ya ma gu ru a bhi ṣiñtsa sid+dhi hūm̐/ de nas drag po mngon spyod mthu yi dbang ni// brub khung thod nang liṅga bcug /spros bcas sgrub dbang dang 'brel na las gzhung gi bsgral las bstab pa dang bcas bya ba yin la/ dkyus tsam du e las brub khung 'di nyid sogs bskyed chog dang*/ bden bdar bcas pa'i 'gug gzhug tshar gsum nas/ hūm̐ thugs rje thabs kyi sbyor ba yi// sogs sngags dang bcas pas phur ba gdab// phur bus btab cing mtshon gyis gtub/ /hūm̐ gdug pa can gyi dgra bgegs la// snying rjes ma rungs sems can ni// 'phrin las drag pos bsgral ba'i phyir// mngon spyod mthu yi dbang bskur ro// dgra bo mā ra ya a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ phur pa liṅga dang sbrag pa slob ma'i lag tu gtad/ slar mdun du bkod la/ yungs kar sogs/ g.yas thun g.yon du rak+sha'i 'phreng*/ /hūm̐ drag po sngags kyi dbang thob nas/ dgra bgegs gdug pa 'joms pa'i phyir// gzi byin skyed pa'i thun dang ni// bgrang 'phreng rak+sha'i dbang bskur ro// thun sngags e ka he dun traka rak+sha ya/ ya ma rā dza sa do me ya/ ya me do ru ṇa yo da ya/ ya da yo ni ra ya k+ṣe ya/ yak+ṣe ya tsa ni ra ma ya/ dgra bo ai myags ya rngubs mug shak+ka dun bh+yo nṛ hur thum dzaḥ mā ra ya rbad/ a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ// sla nga mda' dang 'ur rdo sogs// zor rdzas gtad nas 'di skad du/ /hūm̐ thabs shes nus pa mthar phyin nas// byad ma rdul du rlag pa la// nga rgyal chen pos 'phen byed pa'i// zor rdzas rnams kyi dbang thob shog e ka he dun bh+yo zlog /ya ma rā tsa bh+yo zlog /ma mo e ka dza ṭi bh+yo zlog /mā ra ya zlog /ma mo e ka dza ṭi thun bh+yo zlog /phu sa nā ga gtad khraṃ bh+yo zlog

/phyung phyung*/ shig shig /khrol khrol/ mā ra ya stam+bha ya laṃ nan/ a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ// zor sngags mthar ni a bhi sogs// rigs kyi bu khyed rnams kyis de rnams kyis phyag rgya chen po zil gyis gnon pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang yongs su rdzogs par thob kyis/ deng phyin chad bskyed rdzogs bsnyen bsgrub legs par gyis la/ 'di'i sgo nas dbang dang byin rlabs dang 'chad nyan dang gdug pa can la drag po'i 'phrin las la sogs pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don dpag tu med pa mdzod cig / zhes brjod slob mas 'di skad zhus/ /dpa' bo chen po'i bka' bzhin du// sems can don la brtson par bgyid/ lan gsum/ /bla ma'i sku chu lha tshogs der// nya ldang 'drar bsams yon phul la/ bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal zil gnon gyi dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i sku drin gtang rag gi yon du maṇ+ḍal phul// tshogs la rol cing las kyi rjes// skabs dang bstun nas bsdu bar bya// slob dpon gyis lhag gtor btang*/ chad mdo bsgrags/ rgyun par zor tshab 'phang ba dang*/brtan skyong sogs rjes rim rnams bya/ nyin phyi mar chad mdo'i rjes su lha tshogs rnams bskul nas sgo dbye lam bstan dang bcas/ 'bru nag gi gtor chen lcags sdig gtor bzlog skabs kyi lag len bzhin 'phang nas brtan skyong gtor bro'i bar dang*/ rjes chog lhag chad kha bskang*/ brtan bzhugs shis brjod dge bsngo sogs bya/ ༈ nyin phyi mar skyabs sems nas bzung las byang gzhung bzhin btang*/ bsnyen pa ci nus bya/ tshogs las chad mdo brtan skyong gi bar bsgrub nas// bsgrub rdzogs rdzas kyi dngos grub blang*// zhes pa'i dang po dngos grub len pa la/ dngos grub kyi rdzas 'brang rgyas dang*/ sha zas tshe gal sogs sngar nas bshams zin pa dang*/ gzhan yang tshe ril/ tshe chang*/ mar/ 'khur ba/ thud/ 'ol gon/ 'bras/ zho/ bu ram/ la du/

shing thog sogs bza' btung gi bye brag sna tshogs pa bshams nas/ rdo rje rgyal po la sogs pa'i sgrub pa po rnams dkyil 'khor chen po'i mtha' bskor du 'khod bzhin pas/ hūm̐ yang gsang lha yi dur khrod gzhal yas 'dir/ sogs drag sngags yung thun bcas pas bgegs bskrad la/ hūm̐ chos dbyings rnam dag skye ba med pa'i dbyings/ sogs kyis mtshams bcad/ de nas spos rol dbyangs dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ ye shes sgyu mar rol pa'i thugs rje las// sogs kyis byin dbab cing rol mo bya/ de nas dngos grub bsdu ba ni/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor gyi gtsobo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la oṃ dkar po'i mthar sku yi snying pos bskor ba/ sbyor yum gyi thugs kar dzaḥrang nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ sbyor yum gyi thugs ka'i dzaḥl phog /de las 'od 'phros yab kyi sa bon la phog thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od zer gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros pas/ phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad mchod/ de rnams kyi sku'i byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par bsdus nas thim pa'i mos pas/ sku yi snying po/ oṃ e ka ya ma he dun rak+sha dun dun dza ya/ la/ kā ya badz+ra sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐ btags pa ci mang bzla/ des rigs 'gres kyis dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la āḥyig dmar po'i mthar gsung gi snying pos bskor ba/ sbyor yum gyi thugs kar dzaḥ rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ sbyor yum gyi thugs ka'i dzaḥl phog /de las 'od 'phros yab kyi sa bon la phog thugs rgyud bskul te thugs ka'i sngags phreng las 'od zer gyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros pas phyogs bcu'i zhing gi rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad mchod/ de rnams kyi gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par bsdus nas thim pa

'i mos pas/ gsung gi snying po/ e ka he dun ya ma snying khrag ra ma tsa ya/ la wāk+ka badz+ra sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐/ btags pa bzla/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hūm̐ yig mthing kha'i mthar thugs kyi snying pos bskor ba/ sbyor yum gyi sogs/ thams cad mchod/ de rnams kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs 'od zer mthing kha'i rnam par sogs/ thugs kyi snying po/ e myag ya rngubs mug shaka ka dun/ tsit+ta badz+ra sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐/ btags pa bzla/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la trām̐ yig ser po'i mthar yon tan gyi snying pos bskor ba/ sbyor yum gyi sogs/ thams cad mchod/ de rnams kyi yon tan gyi byin rlabs dang srid zhi'i dpal dang longs spyod thams cad bsdus nas thugs ka'i sa bon sngags dang bcas pa dang*/ gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs bdag dang thod bzang kha sbyor dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams la thim pas yon tan yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bur gyur par bsam la/ e thung la/ gu ṇā badz+ra sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐ btags pa bzla/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la hrīḥyig ljang khu'i mthar phrin las kyi snying pos bskor ba/ sbyor yum gyi sogs/ thams cad mchod/ de rnams kyi phrin las kyi byin bcud bsdus nas thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang sngags phreng las 'od zer me yi tshwa tshwa lta bu 'phros pas gdon bgegs gnod byed dregs pa can rnams bsad gtubs thal bar btang nas de dag gi tshe bsod dbang thang rlung rta dang*/ ye shes lha'i byin rlabs chabs cig tu 'dus thim/ drag po las kyi dngos grub thams cad yongasasu rdzogs par mos la/ a+ye ring mthar/ karma badz+ra sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐ btags pa bzla/ tshe bum dang tshe rdzas bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las tshe rdzas zil gnon lha/ dmar po mnyam gzhag tshe bum can/

thugs kar nṛ las a+ye ring gsum// drag bzlas 'od kyis snod bcud bzhus// tshe lhar 'dus pa'i tshe yi lha// nṛ la dbang bskur bh+rūm̐ gyis bsrung*// hūm̐ gis rdo rje'i drwa mig bsdams// a+ye a+ye a+ye ya ma nṛ bh+rum̐ badz+ra ā yu ṣe hūm̐ dzaḥ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐ btagasapa brgya rtsa bzlas/ brtan g.yo 'khor 'das snod bcud kyi// tshe srog bsod nams dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad tshe'i rang bzhin du bsdus nas thim par mos/ phyi snod nang bcud thams cad sems// 'jig rten dregs pa yab yum thim// yab yum sngags bcas hūm̐ la bsdu// hūm̐ bcas dngos grub rdzas la bsdu// rang gi lus ngag yid la thim/ zhes brjod/ de nas dngos grub bskul ba ni/ hoḥ nam mkha'i khams mnyam zil gnon 'jam pa'i dbyangs// sku yi dngos grub nam mkha'i dkyil yangs bzhin// gsung gi dngos grub 'gag med brjod dang bral// thugs kyi dngos grub mi rtog mnyam pa'i ngang*// yon tan dngos grub yid bzhin rin chen gter// phrin las dngos grub rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub// sku gsungathugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi// dngos grub rnam lnga'i dgos 'dod yid bzhin nor// ji ltar bsam pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// gnas skabs nad gdon bar chad la sogs pa// mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs kun zhi ba dang*// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod dbang*// mnga' thang snyan grags dgos dgu rgyas pa dang*// mos bzhi khams gsum srid gsum lha mi'i nor// yid la gang 'dod dbang du 'du ba dang*// bstan dang bla mar do brdo bdag la 'tshe// dgra bgegs gang byung drag pos bsgral la sogs// rnam bzhi'i las kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// mthar thug bdag don phun tshogs 'jam pa'i dbyangs// ye shes sems dpa'i go 'phang myur thob cing*// gzhan don nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam sems can rnams// gang la gang 'dul gzugs sku'i chos bstan nas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa la rab 'god pa'i// don gnyis phun tshogs dngos grub deng stsol cig
/hūm̐

yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs// bdag nyid rig 'dzin sgrub pa po// dzb bsnyen grangs su thems zin gyis// bskyed rdzogs drod tshad thob zin gyis// thugs dam gnyan po bskang zin gyis// sgrub pa'i zhag grangs tshang zin gyis// rdo rje srin po'i nam langs nye// dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab// dam can thugs dam bdag bskul gyis// sngon gyi thugs bskyed smon lam dang*// dam bca' ma bsnyel deng dgongs la// dngos grub dam pa da lta stsol// lan gsum brjod// de nas dngos grub len pa ni// sgrub po rnams dngos grub kyi rdzas lag tu thogs nas/ dpral bar gtug ste/ hūm̐ dam tshig chen po'i tshul ston khro bo'i tshogs// 'dir gshegs rtags dang mtshan ma myur ston cig /sku yi dbang mchog mi shigs rdo rje yis// gdos bcas lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol// oṃ ya mān+ta ka kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ mgrin par gtug la/ hūm̐ dam tshig chen po'i tshul bstan khro bo'i tshogs// 'dir gshegs rtags dang mtshan ma myur ston cig /gsung gi dbang mchog mi shigs rdo rje yis// 'chal ba ngag gi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol// oṃ ya mān+ta ka wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ snying gar gtug la/ hūm̐ dam tshig chen po'i= /'dir gshegs= thugs kyi dbang= 'khrul pa sems kyi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ gnas gsum du gtug la/ hūm̐ dam tshig chen po'i= 'dir gshegs= /rnam gsum dbang mchog mi shigs rdo rje yis// dug gsum nad gdon sgrib pa sbyang du gsol// oṃ yamān+ta ka sarba sid+dhi hrīḥ sman mchod 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ thod dbus rigs lnga snyoms zhugs bdud rtsi zhu// nyi bkab rta mgrin sbyor mtshams byang sems phab// bdag gi mtheb mdzub zla bas zag dang 'dres// mdangs dri ro bcud gter chen dpa' bos bsrung*// oṃ hūm̐ hrīḥswāhā/ muṃ khaṃ paṃ taṃ laṃ/

oṃ āḥsarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrī tha/ las byang gzhung bzhin byin brlabs nas// mtheb srin gyis 'thor bzhin du/ hūm̐ rang byung gdod nas rnam dag rigs lnga'i rdzas// rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i ra sa na// ye shes lnga las rang byung dug lnga'i sman// dam tshig bdud rtsi mchog gi mchod pa 'bul// oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ+-i ta pū dza hoḥ phyag rgya zil gnon 'jam dpal gshin rje dang*// shrī singha paṇa chen zhi ba'i zhabs// sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol// sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ rgyal po nor 'dzin gnubs chen rdo rje 'chang*// gter ston zhang khrom dhārma kirti dpal// sman mchod= sarba pañtsa= gnubs ston bya bral skal ldan rdo rje rgyal// chos kyi rgyal mtshan gu ru mchog ldan la// sman mchod= /sarba= rgyal mtshan lhun grub tshe bdag bkra shis dang*// kun mkhyen pad dkar mchog gzigs lha rtse'i zhabs// sman mchod/ sarba= dpag bsam dbang po yongs 'dzin kun dga'i mtshan// chos kyi dbang phyug chos rgyal dpal bzang por// sman mchod= /sarba pañtsa= /chos kyi rgyal po phrin las 'gro 'dul rtsal// drin can bla ma ngag dbang bde chen la// sman mchod= /sarba pañtsa= /chos kyi nyi ma gsang bdag grub pa'i dbang*// sgrub rgyud nyi ma rig 'dzin chos skyong mgon// sman mchod= /sarba pañtsa= /bstan pa'i nyi ma dri med grub pa'i dbang*// dkyil 'khor dbang phyug rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ sman mchod= sarba pañtsa= /gzhan yang bka' gter brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// 'jam dpal zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// sman= /sarba pañtsa= dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung gter srung dang*// gnas bdag gzhi bdag dkar phyogs skyong rnams la// sman mchod 'bul lo mthu dbang dngos grub stsol// sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza khā hi/ zhes phul nas/ 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis sku gsungathugs kyi dngos grub thams cad bdag cag dpon slob rnams la da lta nyid du stsal nas/

sku lnga ye shes lnga'i yon tan ma lus pa rtsol ba med par lhun gyis grub par gyur cig /ces gsol ba btab pas dngos grub gnang bar bsam nas/ rdzas rnams la rol lo// de nas smon lam gdab pa ni/ 'di ltar bsags pa'i legs byas mthus// bde gshegs sras bcas thams cad dang*// khyad par 'jam dpal zhi khro yis// tshe rabs kun tu rjes 'dzin shog /'jam dpal dpa' bos ji ltar mkhyen pa dang*/ sogs brjod/ de nas mchod pa rnams kha gsos la/ hūm̐ yaṃ raṃ khaṃ gis mchod rdzas sogs kyis byin brlab/ hūm̐ sna tshogs me tog phreng bas sogs nas bstod pa rdzogs pa'i bar gyis gtang rag gi mchod bstod rgyas par byas nas/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro thams cad dang*// sogs kyis bshags pa dang*/ yig brgya ci mang brjod// lus bsrung rdul tshon chu bor dor// zhes pas/ gnyis pa lus bsrung ba ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid 'jam dpal zil gnon he ru ka /dug ha la 'khyil ba lta bu'i sku/ zhal gsum phyag drug gis mtshon cha sna tshogs gdengs pa/ dpal dang dur khrod drag po'i chas thams cad kyis brgyan cing gar dgu'i nyams kyis sgegs pa'i spyi bor bya khyung dkar po/ dpral bar sku yi khro bo ya ma rā tsa/ mgrin par gsung gi khro bo rta mchog rol pa/ snying khar thugs kyi khro bo phyag rdor ljang nag /lte bar yon tan gyi khro bo rus sbal mi zan/ gsang bar phrin las kyi khro bo rdo rje phur pa/ khro bo thams cad rang rang gi phyag mtshan bsnams shing dpal gyi chas kyis brgyan pa/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ yig gis mtshan par gyur/ cis kyang mi shigs mi tshugs pa'i// stong pa'i go cha bla na med// mtshan ma'i yul kun bcom nas ni// thams cad du ni rgyas par gnas/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐/ rdo rje rgya gram gyi phyag rgyas bka' nan byas pas/ lus thams cad rdo rje rgya gram gyi go chas gtams par

bsam zhing*/ lus bsrung dngos ni 'di skad do/ ming dang mtshan ma ma grub pas// mi gnas mi 'bral 'dus ma byas// chos kyi dbyings kyis bsrung ba na// sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs so// oṃ rak+ṣa maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas phyi rol du song la/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi dang*/ sgo byang la bskyed pa'i khro bo gnyis dang bcas par mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba rnams sngar sta gon gyi skabs bzhin du byas la/ phrin bcol gyi tshab tu mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs/ mthar ye shes pa byang bu la brtan bzhugs bya ba'am/ yang na badz+ra muḥ gshegs gsol byas te byang bu rnams bkrol/ nang du 'ong nas dkyil 'khor chen po'i mtha' skor du sgrub pa po mched lcam rnams phan tshun lag bsnol mar mar me re 'dzin bzhin du 'khod la/ ston pa rdo rje rgyal pos/ dbyangs snyan po dang bcas drangs pa'i rjes zlos gzhan dag gis kyang byas te gdung shugs drag po'i sgo nas smon lam 'di ltar gdab bo/ /hūm̐ dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du// snying po byang chub lam la zhugs pa yis// 'khor ba'i g.yang sa chen por mi ltung zhing*// chags sdang gcong rong gnas su mi skye dang*// log lta dmyal ba'i zangs khar rbab mi 'gril// 'khon 'dzin gcan gzan gdug pa'i skad mi thos// nyon mongs mtshon rtse gdug pa'i zer mi phog /dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' drin che ba dang*// srog gis sbrel ba'i mched dang lcam dral dang*// gsum pa'i dbang gis sbrel ba'i rig ma gsum// skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du// mi 'bral skad cig 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin gyis// sa bcu khyad par rim gyis bgrod par shog /nam zhig tshe 'phos lus brje'i dus byung nas// 'khor ba'i g.yang sar lan gcig ltung srid kyang*// snang ba'i go 'byed zhun mar mdangs gsal 'dis// rig 'dzin sgrub pa po yi shul mtshon cing*// kun tu 'od kyi sa la rgyud sbyangs nas// pad+ma chen po'i sa la lhun gyis grub// 'khor lo tshogs chen sa la gshegs pa'i tshe// sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyis mdun bsus shig

/yi dam lha yis rgyab nas srog brtan cig /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mtha' skyor cig /mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis sna drongs shig /ma tshogs dbang mo rnams kyis rjes skyongs shig /lcang lo can gyi sa la phyin pa'i tshe// mi ldog pa yi sa la gnas nas kyang*// zil gnon khro rgyal khyod kyi zhal mthong nas// rig 'dzin rnams dang dbyer med gyur nas kyang*// bla med sku gsung thugs su 'grub par shog / de nas dkyil 'khor mtha'i khro bcu'i phur pa ma gtogs/ gzhan dkyil 'khor dbus kyi sgrub rdzas sku gsung thugs rten dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan bkod thams cad bsdus nas/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ badz+ra kī la ya uta kī la ya sarba kī la ya badz+ra dhā rota adzñā pa ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes dang*/ hūm̐ bzhi pa'i sngags bzla zhing*/ rkang pa g.yon brkyang dang*/ lag pa skam pa'i rgyas phur bu rnams dang por gdab rim las go ldog tu phyungs te/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lā+o tsa ni sarba ar+tha sā dha ni swā hā/ zhes bzlas pa'i 'o mas phur rtse bkru zhing phur khung la'ang gtor/ de nas dkyil 'khor ras bris yin na/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sogs sam/ 'dir ni gzugs dang sogs kyis brtan bzhugs byas la me tog 'thor nas bsdu/ rdul tshon yin na oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs kyis ye shes pa gshegs nas/ slob dpon gyis a kā ro 'i sngags bzla bzhin du phyag mtshan rdo rjes/ dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa nas brtsams te lte ba'i bar bskor bas re khā gsum 'then cing lha mtshan nas cung zad blangs pa mgo bor bkod/ lhag ma 'phyag pa snod du blug /dri bzang gi chus thig rnams kyang mtha' nas rim bzhin bsrub la/ dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab/ spyi dang khyad par gyi bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// gsum pa rdul tshon chu bor 'dor ba'ang dkyil chog spyi ltar shes par bya'o// snying gzer nag po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga khrag 'thung rol pa'i dga' ston zhes bya ba/

rgyud dang dga' rab rdo rje dang*/ snubs sangs rgyas ye shes la sogs pa'i lung 'thor ba gcig tu bsdus nas skal ldan 'jug pa bde bar/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i slob dpon chen po dag gis rmi lam gyi snang bar bskul bar yang gyur cing*/ sngags 'chang chos rgyal phun tshogs kyis ched du bskul ba'i ngor/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje nyid las chos thams cad la ci dga' bar spyod pa'i lung thob pa pad+ma dkar pos rgyal byed tshal du sbyar ba'o// slad nas/ dkyil chog 'di nyid 'don 'grigs bklag chog tu bkod pa zhig bri bar byos zhes rang gi rigs dbon 'khrul zhig sa sprul mthu stobs grub pa'i dbang phyug mchog gis rten 'brel khyad par can gyi skyes dang bcas nan cher bskul ba dang*/ gzhan yang don gnyer can 'gas nan du bskul bar brten/ mdo khams bzhi pa chos kyi nyi mas stsal ba'i lag len gsal byed dang bstun te/ ngag dbang mthu stobs tshul khrims bstan 'dzin rgya mtshor 'bod pas 'jug bder bkod pa 'dir nongs pa'i cha kun bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha yi spyan sngar snying nas 'chags shing*/ dge bas 'gro kun 'jam dpal zil gnon chen po go 'phang 'thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig //maṅga laṃ//
